texts.1ch.24.20: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.
texts.1ch.24.21: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.
texts.1ch.24.22: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.
texts.1ch.24.23: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jehaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
texts.1ch.24.24: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.
texts.1ch.24.25: The brother of Michah was Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.
texts.1ch.24.26: The sons of Merari were Mahli, and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.
texts.1ch.24.27: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
texts.1ch.24.28: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.
texts.1ch.24.29: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.
texts.1ch.24.30: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.
texts.1ch.24.31: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.
texts.1ch.25.1: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:
texts.1ch.25.2: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, who prophesied according to the order of the king.
texts.1ch.25.3: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the LORD.
texts.1ch.25.4: Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth:
texts.1ch.25.5: All these were the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
texts.1ch.25.6: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the LORD, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.
texts.1ch.25.7: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the LORD, even all that were skillful, was two hundred and eighty eight.
texts.1ch.25.8: And they cast lots, ward against ward, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.
texts.1ch.25.9: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.10: The third to Zaccur, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.11: The fourth to Izri, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.12: The fifth to Nethaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.13: The sixth to Bukkiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.14: The seventh to Jesharelah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.15: The eighth to Jeshaiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.16: The ninth to Mattaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.17: The tenth to Shimei, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.18: The eleventh to Azareel, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.19: The twelfth to Hashabiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.20: The thirteenth to Shubael, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.21: The fourteenth to Mattithiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.22: The fifteenth to Jeremoth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.23: The sixteenth to Hananiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.24: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.25: The eighteenth to Hanani, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.26: The nineteenth to Mallothi, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.27: The twentieth to Eliathah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.28: The one and twentieth to Hothir, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.29: The two and twentieth to Giddalti, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.30: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
texts.1ch.25.31: The four and twentieth to Romamti-ezer, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve.
texts.1ch.26.1: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
texts.1ch.26.2: And the sons of Meshelemiah were, Zechariah the first-born, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
texts.1ch.26.3: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.
texts.1ch.26.4: Moreover the sons of Obed-edom were, Shemaiah the first-born, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,
texts.1ch.26.5: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.
texts.1ch.26.6: Also to Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they were mighty men of valor.
texts.1ch.26.7: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
texts.1ch.26.8: All these of the sons of Obed-edom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, were sixty and two of Obed-edom.
texts.1ch.26.9: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.
texts.1ch.26.10: Also Hosah of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the first-born, yet his father made him the chief;)
texts.1ch.26.11: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.
texts.1ch.26.12: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the LORD.
texts.1ch.26.13: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.
texts.1ch.26.14: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
texts.1ch.26.15: To obed-edom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.
texts.1ch.26.16: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the way of the ascent, ward against ward.
texts.1ch.26.17: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and towards Asuppim, two and two.
texts.1ch.26.18: At Parbar westward, four at the causey, and two at Parbar.
texts.1ch.26.19: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.
texts.1ch.26.20: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
texts.1ch.26.21: As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.
texts.1ch.26.22: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, who were over the treasures of the house of the LORD.
texts.1ch.26.23: Of the Amramites, and the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:
texts.1ch.26.24: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler of the treasures.
texts.1ch.26.25: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
texts.1ch.26.26: Which Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.
texts.1ch.26.27: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the LORD.
texts.1ch.26.28: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.
texts.1ch.26.29: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
texts.1ch.26.30: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valor, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this side of Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD, and in the service of the king.
texts.1ch.26.31: Among the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valor at Jazer of Gilead.
texts.1ch.26.32: And his brethren, men of valor, were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.
texts.1ch.27.1: Now the children of Israel after their number, to wit, the chief fathers, and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.2: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.3: Of the children of Perez, was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.
texts.1ch.27.4: And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.5: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.6: This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course was Ammizabad his son.
texts.1ch.27.7: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.8: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.9: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.10: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.11: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.12: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anetothite, of the Benjaminites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.13: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.14: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.15: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.16: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:
texts.1ch.27.17: Of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:
texts.1ch.27.18: Of Judah, Elihu, one of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:
texts.1ch.27.19: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:
texts.1ch.27.20: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:
texts.1ch.27.21: Of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:
texts.1ch.27.22: Of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Israel.
texts.1ch.27.23: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of the heavens.
texts.1ch.27.24: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Israel; neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.
texts.1ch.27.25: And over the king's treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the store-houses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:
texts.1ch.27.26: And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub:
texts.1ch.27.27: And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:
texts.1ch.27.28: And over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the low plains was Baal-hanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:
texts.1ch.27.29: And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:
texts.1ch.27.30: Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:
texts.1ch.27.31: And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David's.
texts.1ch.27.32: Also Jonathan, David's uncle, was a counselor, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king's sons:
texts.1ch.27.33: And Ahithophel was the king's counselor: and Hushai the Archite was the king's companion:
texts.1ch.27.34: And after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king's army was Joab.
texts.1ch.28.1: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men to Jerusalem.
texts.1ch.28.2: Then David the king stood upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: As for me, I had in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:
texts.1ch.28.3: But God said to me, Thou shalt not build a house for my name, because thou hast been a man of war, and hast shed blood.
texts.1ch.28.4: However the LORD God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah to be the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he approved me to make me king over all Israel:
texts.1ch.28.5: And of all my sons, (for the LORD hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.
texts.1ch.28.6: And he said to me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
texts.1ch.28.7: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he shall be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.
texts.1ch.28.8: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the LORD, and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the LORD your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.
texts.1ch.28.9: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart, and with a willing mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou shalt seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou shalt forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.
texts.1ch.28.10: Take heed now; for the LORD hath chosen thee to build a house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.
texts.1ch.28.11: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses of it, and of its treasuries, and of its upper chambers, and of its inner parlors, and of the place of the mercy-seat,
texts.1ch.28.12: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the LORD, and of all the chambers around, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:
texts.1ch.28.13: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the LORD.
texts.1ch.28.14: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:
texts.1ch.28.15: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for its lamps: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight, both for the candlestick, and also for its lamps, according to the use of every candlestick.
texts.1ch.28.16: And by weight he gave gold for the tables of show-bread, for every table; and likewise silver for the tables of silver:
texts.1ch.28.17: Also pure gold for the flesh-hooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basins he gave gold by weight for every basin; and likewise silver by weight for every basin of silver:
texts.1ch.28.18: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubim, that spread out their wings, and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
texts.1ch.28.19: All this, said David, the LORD made me understand in writing by his hand upon me, even all the works of this pattern.
texts.1ch.28.20: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong, and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed, for the LORD God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD.
texts.1ch.28.21: And behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God: and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skillful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy command.
texts.1ch.29.1: Furthermore David the king said to all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.
texts.1ch.29.2: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to he made of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and the brass for things of brass, the iron for things of iron, and wood for things of wood; onyx-stones, and stones to be set, glittering stones, and of divers colors, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.
texts.1ch.29.3: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of my own possessions, of gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,
texts.1ch.29.4: Even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses:
texts.1ch.29.5: The gold for things of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers. And who then is willing to consecrate his service this day to the LORD?
texts.1ch.29.6: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers over the king's work, offered willingly,
texts.1ch.29.7: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.
texts.1ch.29.8: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the LORD, by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
texts.1ch.29.9: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.
texts.1ch.29.10: Wherefore David blessed the LORD before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed be thou, LORD God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.
texts.1ch.29.11: Thine, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and on the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O LORD, and thou art exalted as head above all.
texts.1ch.29.12: Both riches and honor come from thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thy hand is power and might; and in thy hand it is to make great, and to give strength to all.
texts.1ch.29.13: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.
texts.1ch.29.14: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come from thee, and of thy own have we given thee.
texts.1ch.29.15: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as were all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no abiding.
texts.1ch.29.16: O LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee a house for thy holy name cometh from thy hand, and is all thy own.
texts.1ch.29.17: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, who are present here, to offer willingly to thee.
texts.1ch.29.18: O LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart to thee:
texts.1ch.29.19: And give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision.
texts.1ch.29.20: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the LORD your God. And all the congregation blessed the LORD God of their fathers, and bowed their heads, and worshiped the LORD, and the king.
texts.1ch.29.21: And they sacrificed sacrifices to the LORD, and offered burnt-offerings to the LORD, on the morrow after that day, even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink-offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel:
texts.1ch.29.22: And ate and drank before the LORD on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him to the LORD to be the chief governor, and Zadok to be priest.
texts.1ch.29.23: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
texts.1ch.29.24: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves to Solomon the king.
texts.1ch.29.25: And the LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
texts.1ch.29.26: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
texts.1ch.29.27: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; seven years he reigned in Hebron, and thirty and three years he reigned in Jerusalem.
texts.1ch.29.28: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.
texts.1ch.29.29: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,
texts.1ch.29.30: With all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.

texts.1ch.1.5: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
texts.1ch.1.6: -- And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, and Diphath, and Togarmah.
texts.1ch.1.7: And the sons of Javan: Elishah and Tarshish, Kittim and Rodanim.
texts.1ch.1.8: The sons of Ham: Cush and Mizraim, Phut and Canaan.
texts.1ch.1.9: -- And the sons of Cush: Seba and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raama, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
texts.1ch.1.10: And Cush begot Nimrod: he began to be mighty on the earth.
texts.1ch.1.11: -- And Mizraim begot the Ludim, and the Anamim, and the Lehabim, and the Naphtuhim,
texts.1ch.1.12: and the Pathrusim, and the Casluhim out of whom came the Philistines, and the Caphtorim.
texts.1ch.1.13: -- And Canaan begot Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,
texts.1ch.1.14: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
texts.1ch.1.15: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
texts.1ch.1.16: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
texts.1ch.1.17: The sons of Shem: Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.
texts.1ch.1.18: -- And Arphaxad begot Shelah, and Shelah begot Eber.
texts.1ch.1.19: And to Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother's name was Joktan.
texts.1ch.1.20: And Joktan begot Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
texts.1ch.1.21: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
texts.1ch.1.22: and Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
texts.1ch.1.23: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were sons of Joktan.
texts.1ch.1.28: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
texts.1ch.1.29: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam;
texts.1ch.1.30: Mishma and Dumah; Massa, Hadad, and Tema;
texts.1ch.1.31: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedmah: those are the sons of Ishmael.
texts.1ch.1.32: -- And the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bore Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
texts.1ch.1.33: And the sons of Midian: Ephah, and Epher, and Enoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were sons of Keturah.
texts.1ch.1.34: And Abraham begot Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
texts.1ch.1.35: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
texts.1ch.1.36: -- The sons of Eliphaz: Teman and Omar, Zephi and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
texts.1ch.1.37: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
texts.1ch.1.38: And the sons of Seir: Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.
texts.1ch.1.39: -- And the sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. And Lotan's sister, Timna.
texts.1ch.1.40: -- The sons of Shobal: Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi and Onam. -- And the sons of Zibeon: Ajah and Anah.
texts.1ch.1.41: -- The sons of Anah: Dishon. -- And the sons of Dishon: Hamran, and Eshban, and Jithran, and Cheran.
texts.1ch.1.42: -- The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, and Zaavan, [and] Jaakan. -- The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
texts.1ch.1.43: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before there reigned a king over the children of Israel: -- Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
texts.1ch.1.44: And Bela died; and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
texts.1ch.1.45: And Jobab died; and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
texts.1ch.1.46: And Husham died; and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the fields of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
texts.1ch.1.47: And Hadad died; and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
texts.1ch.1.48: And Samlah died; and Saul of Rehoboth on the river reigned in his stead.
texts.1ch.1.49: And Saul died; and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
texts.1ch.1.50: And Baal-hanan died; and Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife's name was Mehetabel the daughter of Matred, daughter of Mezahab.
texts.1ch.1.51: And Hadad died. And the chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,
texts.1ch.1.52: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
texts.1ch.1.53: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
texts.1ch.1.54: chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
texts.1ch.2.1: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi and Judah, Issachar and Zebulun,
texts.1ch.2.2: Dan, Joseph and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
texts.1ch.2.3: The sons of Judah: Er, and Onan, and Shelah: [which] three were born to him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of Jehovah; and he slew him.
texts.1ch.2.4: And Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Pherez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
texts.1ch.2.5: The sons of Pherez: Hezron and Hamul.
texts.1ch.2.6: And the sons of Zerah: Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.
texts.1ch.2.7: And the sons of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the accursed thing.
texts.1ch.2.8: And the sons of Ethan: Azariah.
texts.1ch.2.9: And the sons of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
texts.1ch.2.10: And Ram begot Amminadab; and Amminadab begot Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
texts.1ch.2.11: and Nahshon begot Salma, and Salma begot Boaz,
texts.1ch.2.12: and Boaz begot Obed, and Obed begot Jesse;
texts.1ch.2.13: and Jesse begot his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimea the third,
texts.1ch.2.14: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
texts.1ch.2.15: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh;
texts.1ch.2.16: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.
texts.1ch.2.17: And Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
texts.1ch.2.18: And Caleb the son of Hezron had children by Azubah [his] wife, and by Jerioth: her sons are these: Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
texts.1ch.2.19: And Azubah died, and Caleb took him Ephrath, and she bore him Hur.
texts.1ch.2.20: And Hur begot Uri, and Uri begot Bezaleel.
texts.1ch.2.21: And afterwards Hezron went to the daughter of Machir, the father of Gilead, and he took her when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.
texts.1ch.2.22: And Segub begot Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead;
texts.1ch.2.23: and Geshur and Aram took the villages of Jair from them, with Kenath and its dependent towns, sixty cities. All these were sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
texts.1ch.2.24: And after the death of Hezron in Caleb-Ephratah, Abijah, Hezron's wife, bore him Ashhur, the father of Tekoa.
texts.1ch.2.25: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were: Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, of Ahijah.
texts.1ch.2.26: And Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
texts.1ch.2.27: And the sons of Ram, the firstborn of Jerahmeel, were Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
texts.1ch.2.28: And the sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. And the sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
texts.1ch.2.29: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bore him Ahban and Molid.
texts.1ch.2.30: And the sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; and Seled died without sons.
texts.1ch.2.31: And the sons of Appaim: Jishi; and the sons of Jishi: Sheshan; and the sons of Sheshan: Ahlai.
texts.1ch.2.32: And the sons of Jada, the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without sons.
texts.1ch.2.33: And the sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
texts.1ch.2.34: And Sheshan had no sons, but daughters; and Sheshan had an Egyptian servant, whose name was Jarha;
texts.1ch.2.35: and Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife, and she bore him Attai.
texts.1ch.2.36: And Attai begot Nathan, and Nathan begot Zabad,
texts.1ch.2.37: and Zabad begot Ephlal, and Ephlal begot Obed,
texts.1ch.2.38: and Obed begot Jehu, and Jehu begot Azariah,
texts.1ch.2.39: and Azariah begot Helez, and Helez begot Elasah,
texts.1ch.2.40: and Elasah begot Sismai, and Sismai begot Shallum,
texts.1ch.2.41: and Shallum begot Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begot Elishama.
texts.1ch.2.42: And the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
texts.1ch.2.43: And the sons of Hebron: Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
texts.1ch.2.44: And Shema begot Raham, the father of Jorkeam. And Rekem begot Shammai;
texts.1ch.2.45: and the son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
texts.1ch.2.46: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bore Haran, and Moza, and Gazez; and Haran begot Gazez.
texts.1ch.2.47: And the sons of Jehdai: Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
texts.1ch.2.48: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah;
texts.1ch.2.49: and she bore Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea. And the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
texts.1ch.2.50: These are the sons of Caleb. The sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah: Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim,
texts.1ch.2.51: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
texts.1ch.2.52: And Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim had sons: Haroeh, Hazi-Hammenuhoth.
texts.1ch.2.53: And the families of Kirjath-jearim were the Jithrites, and the Puthites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zoreathites and the Eshtaolites.
texts.1ch.2.54: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, and the Netophathites. Atroth-Beth-Joab, and the Hazi-Hammana-hethites, the Zorites;
texts.1ch.2.55: and the families of the scribes who dwelt at Jabez: the Tireathites, the Shimeathites, the Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
texts.1ch.3.1: And these are the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jizreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;
texts.1ch.3.2: the third, Absalom the son of Maachah, daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;
texts.1ch.3.3: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream, of Eglah his wife:
texts.1ch.3.4: six were born to him in Hebron. And there he reigned seven years and six months. And in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years.
texts.1ch.3.5: And these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel;
texts.1ch.3.6: and Ibhar, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
texts.1ch.3.7: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
texts.1ch.3.8: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine:
texts.1ch.3.9: all were sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
texts.1ch.3.10: And Solomon's son was Rehoboam; Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
texts.1ch.3.11: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
texts.1ch.3.12: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
texts.1ch.3.13: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
texts.1ch.3.14: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
texts.1ch.3.15: And the sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
texts.1ch.3.16: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
texts.1ch.3.17: And the sons of Jeconiah: Assir; Salathiel his son,
texts.1ch.3.18: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazzar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
texts.1ch.3.19: And the sons of Pedaiah were Zerubbabel and Shimei. And the sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister,
texts.1ch.3.20: and Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, [and] Jushab-hesed, five.
texts.1ch.3.21: And the sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Isaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.
texts.1ch.3.22: And the sons of Shechaniah: Shemaiah; and the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, and Jigeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
texts.1ch.3.23: And the sons of Neariah: Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.
texts.1ch.3.24: And the sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
texts.1ch.4.1: The sons of Judah: Pherez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
texts.1ch.4.2: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begot Jahath; and Jahath begot Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zoreathites.
texts.1ch.4.3: And these [were of] the father of Etam: Jizreel, and Jishma, and Jidbash; and the name of their sister was Hazlelponi;
texts.1ch.4.4: and Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah: these were the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, [and] father of Bethlehem.
texts.1ch.4.5: -- And Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
texts.1ch.4.6: And Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Ahashtari: these were the sons of Naarah.
texts.1ch.4.7: And the sons of Helah: Zereth, and Zohar, and Ethnan.
texts.1ch.4.8: And Koz begot Anub, and Hazzobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
texts.1ch.4.9: And Jabez was more honoured than his brethren; and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bore him with pain.
texts.1ch.4.10: And Jabez called on the God of Israel saying, Oh that thou wouldest richly bless me, and enlarge my border, and that thy hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God brought about what he had requested.
texts.1ch.4.11: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begot Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
texts.1ch.4.12: And Eshton begot Bethrapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of the city of Nahash: these were the men of Rechah.
texts.1ch.4.13: -- And the sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah; and the sons of Othniel: Hathath.
texts.1ch.4.14: And Meonothai begot Ophrah: and Seraiah begot Joab, the father of the valley of craftsmen; for they were craftsmen.
texts.1ch.4.15: -- And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam; and the sons of Elah, ... and Kenaz.
texts.1ch.4.16: -- And the sons of Jehalleleel: Ziph and Ziphah, Tiria and Asareel.
texts.1ch.4.17: -- And the sons of Ezra: Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon; and she conceived [and bore] Miriam, and Shammai, and Jishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
texts.1ch.4.18: And his wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh whom Mered took.
texts.1ch.4.19: -- And the sons of the wife of Hodijah, the sister of Naham: the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
texts.1ch.4.20: -- And the sons of Shimon: Amnon and Rinnah, Ben-hanan and Tilon. -- And the sons of Jishi: Zoheth and Ben-Zoheth.
texts.1ch.4.21: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lechah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of byssus-workers, of the house of Ashbea,
texts.1ch.4.22: and Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who ruled over Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And these are ancient things.
texts.1ch.4.23: These were the potters, and those that abode among plantations and enclosures: there they dwelt with the king for his work.
texts.1ch.4.24: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, [and] Saul;
texts.1ch.4.25: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
texts.1ch.4.26: And the sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son;
texts.1ch.4.27: and Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters. And his brethren had not many sons; neither did all their family multiply like to the sons of Judah.
texts.1ch.4.28: And they abode at Beer-sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-Shual,
texts.1ch.4.29: and at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,
texts.1ch.4.30: and at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,
texts.1ch.4.31: and at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until the reign of David.
texts.1ch.4.32: And their villages were Etam and Ain, Rimmon and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;
texts.1ch.4.33: and all their villages that were round about these cities, as far as Baal. These were their habitations and their genealogical register.
texts.1ch.4.34: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,
texts.1ch.4.35: and Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
texts.1ch.4.36: and Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
texts.1ch.4.37: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah:
texts.1ch.4.38: these mentioned by name were princes in their families; and their fathers' houses increased greatly.
texts.1ch.4.39: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, as far as the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
texts.1ch.4.40: And they found fat and good pasture, and a land widely extended and quiet and fertile, for they who had dwelt there formerly were of Ham.
texts.1ch.4.41: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their stead; for there was pasture there for their flocks.
texts.1ch.4.42: And five hundred men of them, of the sons of Simeon, went to mount Seir, having at their head Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Jishi,
texts.1ch.4.43: and they smote the rest of the Amalekites that had escaped; and they dwelt there unto this day.
texts.1ch.5.1: And the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (for he was the firstborn; but, inasmuch as he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; but the genealogy is not registered according to the birthright,
texts.1ch.5.2: for Judah prevailed among his brethren, and of him was the prince, but the birthright was Joseph's),
texts.1ch.5.3: -- the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: Enoch and Phallu, Hezron and Carmi.
texts.1ch.5.4: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
texts.1ch.5.5: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
texts.1ch.5.6: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.
texts.1ch.5.7: And his brethren by their families, in the genealogical register of their generations, were: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
texts.1ch.5.8: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, as far as Nebo and Baal-meon;
texts.1ch.5.9: and eastward he dwelt as far as the entrance to the wilderness from the river Euphrates; for their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
texts.1ch.5.10: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand; and they dwelt in their tents throughout the east side of Gilead.
texts.1ch.5.11: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan, as far as Salcah:
texts.1ch.5.12: Joel was the chief and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
texts.1ch.5.13: And their brethren according to their fathers' houses were Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jaachan, and Zia, and Eber, seven.
texts.1ch.5.14: -- These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz:
texts.1ch.5.15: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, was chief of their fathers' house.
texts.1ch.5.16: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in its towns, and in all the pasture-grounds of Sharon, as far as their limits.
texts.1ch.5.17: All these were registered by genealogy in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
texts.1ch.5.18: The children of Reuben and the Gadites and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men who carried shield and sword, drawing the bow and skilful in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred and sixty, able to go forth to war.
texts.1ch.5.19: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab;
texts.1ch.5.20: and they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them, because they put their trust in him.
texts.1ch.5.21: And they took away their cattle: their camels fifty thousand, and two hundred and fifty thousand sheep, and two thousand asses, and a hundred thousand human souls.
texts.1ch.5.22: For there fell down many slain, for the war was of God. And they dwelt in their stead until the captivity.
texts.1ch.5.23: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land, from Bashan as far as Baal-Hermon and Senir, and mount Hermon; they were many.
texts.1ch.5.24: And these were the heads of their fathers' houses: Epher, and Jishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, heads of their fathers' houses.
texts.1ch.5.25: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.
texts.1ch.5.26: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath-Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, -- unto this day.
texts.1ch.6.1: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
texts.1ch.6.2: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, Jizhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
texts.1ch.6.3: And the children of Amram: Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. And the sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
texts.1ch.6.4: Eleazar begot Phinehas; Phinehas begot Abishua,
texts.1ch.6.5: and Abishua begot Bukki, and Bukki begot Uzzi,
texts.1ch.6.6: and Uzzi begot Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begot Meraioth;
texts.1ch.6.7: Meraioth begot Amariah, and Amariah begot Ahitub,
texts.1ch.6.8: and Ahitub begot Zadok, and Zadok begot Ahimaaz,
texts.1ch.6.9: and Ahimaaz begot Azariah, and Azariah begot Johanan,
texts.1ch.6.10: and Johanan begot Azariah (he is it that exercised the priesthood in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem);
texts.1ch.6.11: and Azariah begot Amariah, and Amariah begot Ahitub,
texts.1ch.6.12: and Ahitub begot Zadok, and Zadok begot Shallum,
texts.1ch.6.13: and Shallum begot Hilkijah, and Hilkijah begot Azariah,
texts.1ch.6.14: and Azariah begot Seraiah, and Seraiah begot Jehozadak,
texts.1ch.6.15: and Jehozadak went away, when Jehovah carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
texts.1ch.6.16: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
texts.1ch.6.17: And these are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
texts.1ch.6.18: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, and Jizhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
texts.1ch.6.19: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. And these are the families of Levi according to their fathers.
texts.1ch.6.20: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
texts.1ch.6.21: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeathrai his son.
texts.1ch.6.22: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
texts.1ch.6.23: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
texts.1ch.6.24: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Saul his son.
texts.1ch.6.25: And the sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.
texts.1ch.6.26: Elkanah, -- the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
texts.1ch.6.27: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
texts.1ch.6.28: And the sons of Samuel: the firstborn Vashni and Abijah.
texts.1ch.6.29: The sons of Merari: Mahli; Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
texts.1ch.6.30: Shimea his son, Haggijah his son, Asaiah his son.
texts.1ch.6.31: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of Jehovah after that the ark was in rest.
texts.1ch.6.32: And they ministered before the tabernacle of the tent of meeting with singing, until Solomon had built the house of Jehovah in Jerusalem; and they attended to their office according to their order.
texts.1ch.6.33: And these are they that attended, and their sons: Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
texts.1ch.6.34: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
texts.1ch.6.35: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
texts.1ch.6.36: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
texts.1ch.6.37: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
texts.1ch.6.38: the son of Jizhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
texts.1ch.6.39: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand: Asaph, the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,
texts.1ch.6.40: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
texts.1ch.6.41: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
texts.1ch.6.42: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
texts.1ch.6.43: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
texts.1ch.6.44: And their brethren the sons of Merari were on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
texts.1ch.6.45: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkijah,
texts.1ch.6.46: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
texts.1ch.6.47: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
texts.1ch.6.48: And their brethren the Levites were given for all the service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
texts.1ch.6.49: And Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt-offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
texts.1ch.6.50: And these are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
texts.1ch.6.51: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
texts.1ch.6.52: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
texts.1ch.6.53: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
texts.1ch.6.54: And these are their dwelling-places according to their encampments, within their borders. For the sons of Aaron, of the family of the Kohathites, for theirs was the lot;
texts.1ch.6.55: and they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and its suburbs round about it;
texts.1ch.6.56: but the fields of the city, and the hamlets thereof gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
texts.1ch.6.57: And to the children of Aaron they gave the city of refuge, Hebron; and Libnah and its suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa and its suburbs,
texts.1ch.6.58: and Hilen and its suburbs, Debir and its suburbs,
texts.1ch.6.59: and Ashan and its suburbs, and Beth-shemesh and its suburbs;
texts.1ch.6.60: and, out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba and its suburbs, and Allemeth and its suburbs, and Anathoth and its suburbs: all their cities, thirteen cities, according to their families.
texts.1ch.6.61: And to the children of Kohath that remained [were given] by lot out of the families of the tribe [of Ephraim and of the tribe of Dan and] of the half tribe, half Manasseh, ten cities.
texts.1ch.6.62: And to the children of Gershom according to their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
texts.1ch.6.63: To the children of Merari [were given] by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
texts.1ch.6.64: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities and their suburbs.
texts.1ch.6.65: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which were mentioned by name.
texts.1ch.6.66: And to the families of the children of Kohath who had the cities of their territory out of the tribe of Ephraim,
texts.1ch.6.67: they gave the city of refuge, Shechem and its suburbs in mount Ephraim; and Gezer and its suburbs,
texts.1ch.6.68: and Jokmeam and its suburbs, and Beth-horon and its suburbs,
texts.1ch.6.69: and Ajalon and its suburbs, and Gath-Rimmon and its suburbs;
texts.1ch.6.70: and out of the half tribe of Manasseh: Aner and its suburbs, and Bileam and its suburbs, -- for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.
texts.1ch.6.71: To the children of Gershom [were given] out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and its suburbs, and Ashtaroth and its suburbs;
texts.1ch.6.72: and out of the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh and its suburbs, Dobrath and its suburbs,
texts.1ch.6.73: and Ramoth and its suburbs, and Anem and its suburbs;
texts.1ch.6.74: and out of the tribe of Asher: Mashal and its suburbs, and Abdon and its suburbs,
texts.1ch.6.75: and Hukok and its suburbs, and Rehob and its suburbs;
texts.1ch.6.76: and out of the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee and its suburbs, and Hammon and its suburbs, and Kirjathaim and its suburbs.
texts.1ch.6.77: To the children of Merari that remained [were given] out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono and its suburbs, [and] Tabor and its suburbs;
texts.1ch.6.78: and on the other side of the Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, out of the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness and its suburbs, and Jahzah and its suburbs,
texts.1ch.6.79: and Kedemoth and its suburbs, and Mephaath and its suburbs;
texts.1ch.6.80: and out of the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead and its suburbs, and Mahanaim and its suburbs,
texts.1ch.6.81: and Heshbon and its suburbs, and Jaazer and its suburbs.
texts.1ch.7.1: And the sons of Issachar were Tola and Puah, Jashub and Shimron, four.
texts.1ch.7.2: And the sons of Tola: Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Samuel, heads of their fathers' houses, of Tola, valiant men of might in their generations; their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
texts.1ch.7.3: And the sons of Uzzi: Jizrahiah; and the sons of Jizrahiah: Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, [and] Jishijah, five; all of them chief men.
texts.1ch.7.4: And with them by their generations, according to their fathers' houses, were military bands for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.
texts.1ch.7.5: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar valiant men of might, registered by genealogy, in all eighty-seven thousand.
texts.1ch.7.6: [The sons of] Benjamin: Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.
texts.1ch.7.7: And the sons of Bela: Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers' houses, mighty men of valour; and they were registered by their genealogy twenty-two thousand and thirty-four.
texts.1ch.7.8: And the sons of Becher: Zemirah, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jeremoth, and Abijah, and Anathoth, and Alemeth; all these were the sons of Becher.
texts.1ch.7.9: And they were registered by their genealogy by their generations, heads of their fathers' houses, mighty men of valour, twenty thousand two hundred.
texts.1ch.7.10: And the sons of Jediael: Bilhan; and the sons of Bilhan: Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
texts.1ch.7.11: All these were the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, seventeen thousand two hundred, fit for service for war.
texts.1ch.7.12: And Shuppim, and Huppim, the children of Ir. -- Hushim: the sons of Aher.
texts.1ch.7.13: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
texts.1ch.7.14: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, ... whom she bore; his Syrian concubine bore Machir the father of Gilead.
texts.1ch.7.15: And Machir took a wife [the sister] of Huppim and Shuppim, and the name of their sister was Maachah. And the name of the second [son] was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.
texts.1ch.7.16: And Maachah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
texts.1ch.7.17: And the sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
texts.1ch.7.18: And his sister Moleketh bore Ishhod, and Abiezer, and Mahlah.
texts.1ch.7.19: And the sons of Shemidah were Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
texts.1ch.7.20: And the sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,
texts.1ch.7.21: and Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elad. And the men of Gath born in the land slew them, because they came down to take their cattle.
texts.1ch.7.22: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
texts.1ch.7.23: And he went in to his wife; and she conceived, and bore a son; and he called his name Beriah, for [he was born] when calamity was in his house.
texts.1ch.7.24: And his daughter was Sheerah; and she built Beth-horon the nether, and the upper, and Uzzen-sheerah.
texts.1ch.7.25: And his son was Rephah, and Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
texts.1ch.7.26: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
texts.1ch.7.27: Nun his son, Joshua his son.
texts.1ch.7.28: And their possession and dwelling-places were Bethel and its dependent villages, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer and its dependent villages, and Shechem and its dependent villages as far as to Gazah and its dependent villages.
texts.1ch.7.29: And in the hands of the children of Manasseh, Beth-shean and its dependent villages, Taanach and its dependent villages, Megiddo and its dependent villages, Dor and its dependent villages. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
texts.1ch.7.30: The sons of Asher: Jimnah, and Jishvah, and Jishvi, and Beriah; Serah their sister.
texts.1ch.7.31: And the sons of Beriah: Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.
texts.1ch.7.32: And Heber begot Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
texts.1ch.7.33: And the sons of Japhlet: Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath; these are the sons of Japhlet.
texts.1ch.7.34: And the sons of Shemer: Ahi, and Rohgah, and Hubbah, and Aram.
texts.1ch.7.35: And the sons of his brother Helem: Zophah, and Jimna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
texts.1ch.7.36: The sons of Zophah: Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Jimrah,
texts.1ch.7.37: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Jithran, and Beera.
texts.1ch.7.38: And the sons of Jether: Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.
texts.1ch.7.39: And the sons of Ulla: Arah, and Hanniel, and Rizia.
texts.1ch.7.40: All these were the sons of Asher, heads of fathers' houses, choice men, mighty of valour, chiefs of the princes. And their number according to their genealogy, registered as fit for service for war, was twenty-six thousand men.
texts.1ch.8.1: And Benjamin begot Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
texts.1ch.8.2: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
texts.1ch.8.3: And Bela had sons: Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,
texts.1ch.8.4: and Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,
texts.1ch.8.5: and Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.
texts.1ch.8.6: -- And these are the sons of Ehud (these were the chief fathers of the inhabitants of Geba; and they carried them away to Manahath;
texts.1ch.8.7: even Naaman, and Ahijah, and Gera; he removed them), and he begot Uzza and Ahihud.
texts.1ch.8.8: And Shaharaim begot [children] in the land of Moab after he had sent away Hushim and Baara his wives.
texts.1ch.8.9: And he begot of Hodesh his wife: Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,
texts.1ch.8.10: and Jeuz, and Shobia, and Mirmah; these were his sons, chief fathers.
texts.1ch.8.11: And of Hushim he begot Abitub, and Elpaal.
texts.1ch.8.12: And the sons of Elpaal: Eber, and Misham, and Shemer, who built Ono, and Lod and its dependent villages;
texts.1ch.8.13: and Beriah, and Shema, who were chief fathers of the inhabitants of Ajalon; they drove away the inhabitants of Gath.
texts.1ch.8.15: and Zebadiah, and Arad, and Eder,
texts.1ch.8.16: and Michael, and Jishpah, and Joha were the sons of Beriah.
texts.1ch.8.17: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hiski, and Heber,
texts.1ch.8.18: and Jishmerai, and Jizliah, and Jobab were the sons of Elpaal.
texts.1ch.8.19: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
texts.1ch.8.20: and Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,
texts.1ch.8.21: and Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath were the sons of Shimei.
texts.1ch.8.22: And Jishpah, and Eber, and Eliel,
texts.1ch.8.23: and Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
texts.1ch.8.24: and Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,
texts.1ch.8.25: and Jiphdeiah, and Penuel were the sons of Shashak.
texts.1ch.8.26: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,
texts.1ch.8.27: and Jaareshiah, and Elijah, and Zichri were the sons of Jeroham.
texts.1ch.8.28: These were the chief fathers, according to their generations, principal men; these dwelt in Jerusalem.
texts.1ch.8.29: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; and his wife's name was Maachah.
texts.1ch.8.30: And his son, the firstborn, was Abdon; and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
texts.1ch.8.31: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zecher.
texts.1ch.8.32: And Mikloth begot Shimeah. And these also dwelt beside their brethren in Jerusalem, with their brethren.
texts.1ch.8.33: And Ner begot Kish; and Kish begot Saul; and Saul begot Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
texts.1ch.8.34: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-Baal; and Merib-Baal begot Micah.
texts.1ch.8.35: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.
texts.1ch.8.36: And Ahaz begot Jehoaddah; and Jehoaddah begot Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begot Moza;
texts.1ch.8.37: and Moza begot Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
texts.1ch.8.38: And Azel had six sons, and these are their names: Azrikam, Bochru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan; all these were sons of Azel.
texts.1ch.8.39: And the sons of Eshek his brother were Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
texts.1ch.8.40: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers; and they had many sons, and sons' sons, a hundred and fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.
texts.1ch.9.1: And all Israel were registered by genealogy; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. And Judah was carried away to Babylon because of their transgression.
texts.1ch.9.2: And the inhabitants that were first in their possessions in their cities were the Israelites, the priests, the Levites, and the Nethinim.
texts.1ch.9.3: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh:
texts.1ch.9.4: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pherez the son of Judah.
texts.1ch.9.5: And of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.
texts.1ch.9.6: And of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel; and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
texts.1ch.9.7: And of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah,
texts.1ch.9.8: and Jibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Jibnijah;
texts.1ch.9.9: and their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty-six. All these men were chief fathers in their fathers' houses.
texts.1ch.9.10: And of the priests: Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,
texts.1ch.9.11: and Azariah the son of Hilkijah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
texts.1ch.9.12: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah, and Masai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
texts.1ch.9.13: and their brethren, heads of their fathers' houses, a thousand and seven hundred and sixty; able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
texts.1ch.9.14: And of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
texts.1ch.9.15: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal; and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
texts.1ch.9.16: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.
texts.1ch.9.17: And the doorkeepers: Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren; Shallum was the chief.
texts.1ch.9.18: And they have been hitherto in the king's gate eastward: they were the doorkeepers in the camps of the children of Levi.
texts.1ch.9.19: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent, and their fathers, set over the camp of Jehovah, were keepers of the entrance.
texts.1ch.9.20: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them formerly; Jehovah was with him.
texts.1ch.9.21: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was doorkeeper at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
texts.1ch.9.22: All these chosen to be doorkeepers at the thresholds were two hundred and twelve. These were registered by genealogy according to their villages: David and Samuel the seer had instituted them in their trust.
texts.1ch.9.23: And they and their sons were at the gates of the house of Jehovah, the house of the tent, to keep watch there.
texts.1ch.9.24: At the four quarters were the doorkeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.
texts.1ch.9.25: And their brethren, in their villages, were to come after [every] seven days from time to time with them.
texts.1ch.9.26: For in their trust these four were the chief doorkeepers: they were Levites; and they were over the chambers and over the treasuries of the house of God;
texts.1ch.9.27: for they stayed round about the house of God during the night, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning [pertained] to them.
texts.1ch.9.28: And [part] of them had the charge of the instruments of service, for by number they brought them in and by number they brought them out.
texts.1ch.9.29: [Part] of them also were appointed over the vessels, and over all the holy instruments, and over the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
texts.1ch.9.30: And it was [some one] of the sons of the priests who compounded the ointment of the spices.
texts.1ch.9.31: And Mattithiah of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, was in trust over the things that were made in the pans.
texts.1ch.9.32: And [some] of the sons of the Kohathites, their brethren, were over the loaves to be set in rows, to prepare them every sabbath.
texts.1ch.9.33: And these were the singers, chief fathers of the Levites, [who were] in the chambers free from service; for they were employed day and night.
texts.1ch.9.34: These are the chief fathers of the Levites, heads according to their families; these dwelt in Jerusalem.
texts.1ch.9.35: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, and his wife's name was Maachah.
texts.1ch.9.36: And his son, the firstborn, was Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
texts.1ch.9.37: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth;
texts.1ch.9.38: and Mikloth begot Shimeam. And they also dwelt beside their brethren in Jerusalem, with their brethren.
texts.1ch.9.39: And Ner begot Kish; and Kish begot Saul; and Saul begot Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
texts.1ch.9.40: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-Baal; and Merib-Baal begot Micah.
texts.1ch.9.41: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea.
texts.1ch.9.42: And Ahaz begot Jarah: and Jarah begot Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begot Moza;
texts.1ch.9.43: and Moza begot Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
texts.1ch.9.44: And Azel had six sons, and these are their names: Azrikam, Bochru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan; these were the sons of Azel.
texts.1ch.10.1: And the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on mount Gilboa.
texts.1ch.10.2: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines smote Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, Saul's sons.
texts.1ch.10.3: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers came up with him, and he was terrified by the archers.
texts.1ch.10.4: Then said Saul to his armour-bearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through with it; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armour-bearer would not; for he was much afraid. So Saul took the sword and fell on it.
texts.1ch.10.5: And when his armour-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.
texts.1ch.10.6: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.
texts.1ch.10.7: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook their cities and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
texts.1ch.10.8: And it came to pass the next day, that the Philistines came to strip the slain, and they found Saul and his sons fallen on mount Gilboa.
texts.1ch.10.9: And they stripped him, and took his head, and his armour, and sent [them] into the land of the Philistines round about, to announce the glad tidings to their idols, and to the people.
texts.1ch.10.10: And they put his armour in the house of their god, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.
texts.1ch.10.11: And when all they of Jabesh-Gilead heard of all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
texts.1ch.10.12: all the valiant men arose, and took up the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the terebinth of Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
texts.1ch.10.13: And Saul died for his unfaithfulness which he committed against Jehovah, because of the word of Jehovah which he kept not, and also for having inquired of the spirit of Python, asking counsel of it;
texts.1ch.10.14: and he asked not counsel of Jehovah; therefore he slew him, and transferred the kingdom to David the son of Jesse.
texts.1ch.11.1: And all Israel assembled themselves to David to Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
texts.1ch.11.2: Even aforetime, even when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel; and Jehovah thy God said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be prince over my people Israel.
texts.1ch.11.3: And all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Jehovah; and they anointed David king over Israel according to the word of Jehovah through Samuel.
texts.1ch.11.4: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.
texts.1ch.11.5: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come in hither. But David took the stronghold of Zion, which is the city of David.
texts.1ch.11.6: And David said, Whoever smites the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. And Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.
texts.1ch.11.7: And David dwelt in the stronghold; therefore they called it the city of David.
texts.1ch.11.8: And he built the city round about, even from the Millo round about; and Joab renewed the rest of the city.
texts.1ch.11.9: And David became continually greater; and Jehovah of hosts was with him.
texts.1ch.11.10: And these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who shewed themselves valiant with him in his kingdom, with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of Jehovah concerning Israel.
texts.1ch.11.11: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of Hachmoni, the chief of the captains; he brandished his spear against three hundred, slain [by him] at one time.
texts.1ch.11.12: And after him, Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite; he was one of the three mighty men.
texts.1ch.11.13: He was with David at Pas-dammim, where the Philistines were gathered together to battle; and there was [there] a plot of ground full of barley; and the people had fled from before the Philistines.
texts.1ch.11.14: And they stood in the midst of the plot and delivered it, and smote the Philistines; and Jehovah wrought a great deliverance.
texts.1ch.11.15: And three of the thirty chiefs went down to the rock to David, to the cave of Adullam, when the army of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
texts.1ch.11.16: And David was then in the stronghold; and the Philistines' garrison was then at Bethlehem.
texts.1ch.11.17: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me to drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, which is in the gate!
texts.1ch.11.18: And the three broke through the camp of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, which is in the gate, and took it, and brought it to David; David however would not drink of it, but poured it out to Jehovah.
texts.1ch.11.19: And he said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing! should I drink the blood of these men [who went] at the risk of their lives? for at the risk of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did the three mighty men.
texts.1ch.11.20: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was the chief of three; and he brandished his spear against three hundred and slew them; and he had a name among the three.
texts.1ch.11.21: Of the three he was more honourable than the two, and he was their captain; but he did not attain to the [first] three.
texts.1ch.11.22: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, great in exploits, of Kabzeel: he it was that smote two lions of Moab; and he went down and smote a lion in the midst of a pit on a snowy day.
texts.1ch.11.23: He also smote the Egyptian, a man of stature, five cubits high: and in the Egyptian's hand was a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.
texts.1ch.11.24: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and he had a name among the three mighty men.
texts.1ch.11.25: Behold, he was honoured above the thirty, but he did not attain to the [first] three. And David set him in his council.
texts.1ch.11.26: And the valiant men of the forces were: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
texts.1ch.11.27: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
texts.1ch.11.28: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
texts.1ch.11.29: Sibbechai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
texts.1ch.11.30: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
texts.1ch.11.31: Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
texts.1ch.11.32: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
texts.1ch.11.33: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
texts.1ch.11.34: Bene-Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,
texts.1ch.11.35: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
texts.1ch.11.36: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
texts.1ch.11.37: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
texts.1ch.11.38: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,
texts.1ch.11.39: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armour-bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,
texts.1ch.11.40: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
texts.1ch.11.41: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
texts.1ch.11.42: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him;
texts.1ch.11.43: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
texts.1ch.11.44: Uzzia the Ashtarothite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
texts.1ch.11.45: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
texts.1ch.11.46: Eliel of Mahavim, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Jithmah the Moabite,
texts.1ch.11.47: Eliel, and Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
texts.1ch.12.1: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he kept still close because of Saul the son of Kish; and they were among the mighty men who helped him in the conflict;
texts.1ch.12.2: armed with bows, using both the right hand and the left with stones and with arrows on the bow; [they were] of Saul's brethren of Benjamin:
texts.1ch.12.3: the chief Ahiezer, and Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Anathothite,
texts.1ch.12.4: and Jishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Jozabad the Gederathite.
texts.1ch.12.5: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite;
texts.1ch.12.6: Elkanah, and Jishijah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;
texts.1ch.12.7: and Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
texts.1ch.12.8: And of the Gadites, there separated themselves to David in the stronghold in the wilderness mighty men of valour, men fit for the service of war, armed with shield and spear; whose faces were [like] the faces of lions, and who were swift as the gazelles upon the mountains:
texts.1ch.12.9: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
texts.1ch.12.10: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
texts.1ch.12.11: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
texts.1ch.12.12: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
texts.1ch.12.13: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbannai the eleventh.
texts.1ch.12.14: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over a hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.
texts.1ch.12.15: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it overflows all its banks, and they put to flight all [them] of the valleys, toward the east and toward the west.
texts.1ch.12.16: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the stronghold to David.
