texts.1ch.12.17: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said to them, If ye come peaceably to me to help me, my heart shall be knit unto you; but if to betray me to mine enemies, seeing there is no wrong in my hands, the God of our fathers see [it] and rebuke [it].
texts.1ch.12.18: And the Spirit came upon Amasai, the chief of the captains, [and he said,] Thine [are we], David, And with thee, thou son of Jesse: Peace, peace be to thee! And peace be to thy helpers! For thy God helps thee. And David received them, and made them chiefs of bands.
texts.1ch.12.19: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not; for the lords of the Philistines upon deliberation sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul at the peril of our heads.
texts.1ch.12.20: As he went away to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh: Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.
texts.1ch.12.21: And they helped David in his expeditions; for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.
texts.1ch.12.22: For day by day there came [men] to David to help him, until it was a great camp, like the camp of God.
texts.1ch.12.23: And this is the number of the men equipped for military service, who came to David to Hebron, to transfer the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of Jehovah.
texts.1ch.12.24: The children of Judah that bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, equipped for military service.
texts.1ch.12.25: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for war, seven thousand one hundred.
texts.1ch.12.26: Of the children of Levi four thousand six hundred.
texts.1ch.12.27: And Jehoiada the prince of Aaron, and with him were three thousand seven hundred;
texts.1ch.12.28: and Zadok, a valiant young man, and his father's house two and twenty chief men.
texts.1ch.12.29: And of the children of Benjamin, the brethren of Saul, three thousand; but hitherto the greater part of them had adhered to the house of Saul.
texts.1ch.12.30: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valour, men of name in their fathers' houses.
texts.1ch.12.31: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, who were expressed by name, to come and make David king.
texts.1ch.12.32: And of the children of Issachar, who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their bidding.
texts.1ch.12.33: Of Zebulun, such as went forth in the host, armed for war with all weapons of war, fifty thousand, keeping rank without double heart.
texts.1ch.12.34: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them thirty-seven thousand with shield and spear.
texts.1ch.12.35: And of the Danites armed for war twenty-eight thousand six hundred.
texts.1ch.12.36: And of Asher such as went forth in the host, to set themselves in battle array, forty thousand.
texts.1ch.12.37: And from the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of weapons of war for battle, a hundred and twenty thousand.
texts.1ch.12.38: All of them men of war, keeping rank in battle array, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
texts.1ch.12.39: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brethren had prepared for them;
texts.1ch.12.40: and those too that were near them, as far as Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought food on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen; provisions of meal, fig-cakes and raisin-cakes, and wine and oil, and oxen and sheep, abundantly; for there was joy in Israel.
texts.1ch.13.1: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, with every prince.
texts.1ch.13.2: And David said to all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good to you, and it be of Jehovah our God, let us send abroad to our brethren everywhere, that are left in all the lands of Israel, and with them to the priests and Levites in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves to us;
texts.1ch.13.3: and let us bring again the ark of our God to us; for we inquired not of it in the days of Saul.
texts.1ch.13.4: And all the congregation said that they should do so; for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
texts.1ch.13.5: And David assembled all Israel from the Shihor of Egypt unto the entrance of Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath-jearim.
texts.1ch.13.6: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, to Kirjath-jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from thence the ark of God, of Jehovah, who sitteth between the cherubim, whose name is placed [there].
texts.1ch.13.7: And they carried the ark of God on a new cart out of the house of Abinadab; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.
texts.1ch.13.8: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with lutes, and with tambours, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
texts.1ch.13.9: And when they came to the threshing-floor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen had stumbled.
texts.1ch.13.10: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he had put forth his hand to the ark; and there he died before God.
texts.1ch.13.11: And David was indignant; for Jehovah had made a breach upon Uzza; and he called that place Perez-Uzza to this day.
texts.1ch.13.12: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God to me?
texts.1ch.13.13: And David brought not the ark home unto himself into the city of David, but he carried it aside into the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.
texts.1ch.13.14: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months. And Jehovah blessed the house of Obed-Edom, and all that he had.
texts.1ch.14.1: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him a house.
texts.1ch.14.2: And David perceived that Jehovah had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, because of his people Israel.
texts.1ch.14.3: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begot more sons and daughters.
texts.1ch.14.4: And these are the names of the children which he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
texts.1ch.14.5: and Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpelet,
texts.1ch.14.6: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
texts.1ch.14.7: and Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphelet.
texts.1ch.14.8: And the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, and all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard [of it], and went out against them.
texts.1ch.14.9: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
texts.1ch.14.10: And David inquired of God saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines, and wilt thou give them into my hand? And Jehovah said to him, Go up; and I will give them into thy hand.
texts.1ch.14.11: And they came up to Baal-perazim, and David smote them there; and David said, God has broken in upon mine enemies by my hand, as the breaking forth of waters. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.
texts.1ch.14.12: And they left their gods there; and David commanded, and they were burned with fire.
texts.1ch.14.13: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves in the valley.
texts.1ch.14.14: And David inquired again of God; and God said to him, Go not up after them; turn round them and come upon them opposite the mulberry-trees.
texts.1ch.14.15: And it shall be, when thou hearest the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry-trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle; for God will have gone forth before thee to smite the army of the Philistines.
texts.1ch.14.16: And David did as God commanded him; and they smote the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.
texts.1ch.14.17: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and Jehovah brought the fear of him upon all the nations.
texts.1ch.15.1: And he made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and spread a tent for it.
texts.1ch.15.2: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites, for them has Jehovah chosen to carry the ark of God, and to serve him for ever.
texts.1ch.15.3: And David assembled all Israel to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of Jehovah to its place that he had prepared for it.
texts.1ch.15.4: And David gathered the sons of Aaron and the Levites:
texts.1ch.15.5: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brethren a hundred and twenty;
texts.1ch.15.6: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty;
texts.1ch.15.7: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brethren a hundred and thirty;
texts.1ch.15.8: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred;
texts.1ch.15.9: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brethren eighty;
texts.1ch.15.10: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brethren a hundred and twelve.
texts.1ch.15.11: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab;
texts.1ch.15.12: and he said to them, Ye are the chief fathers of the Levites; hallow yourselves, ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of Jehovah the God of Israel to [the place that] I have prepared for it.
texts.1ch.15.13: For because ye did [it] not at the first, Jehovah our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.
texts.1ch.15.14: So the priests and the Levites hallowed themselves to bring up the ark of Jehovah the God of Israel.
texts.1ch.15.15: And the children of the Levites bore the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves upon them, as Moses had commanded according to the word of Jehovah.
texts.1ch.15.16: And David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren, the singers, with instruments of music, lutes, and harps, and cymbals, that they should sound aloud, lifting up the voice with joy.
texts.1ch.15.17: And the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
texts.1ch.15.18: and with them their brethren of the second [rank], Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers;
texts.1ch.15.19: and the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, to sound aloud with cymbals of brass;
texts.1ch.15.20: and Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with lutes on Alamoth;
texts.1ch.15.21: and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-Edom and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to lead [the singing].
texts.1ch.15.22: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites for the music, gave instruction in music, for he was skilful.
texts.1ch.15.23: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
texts.1ch.15.24: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew with the trumpets before the ark of God; and Obed-Edom and Jehijah were doorkeepers for the ark.
texts.1ch.15.25: And David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of Jehovah out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.
texts.1ch.15.26: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bore the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, that they sacrificed seven bullocks and seven rams.
texts.1ch.15.27: And David was clothed with a robe of byssus, and all the Levites that bore the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah chief of the music of the singers; and David had upon him a linen ephod.
texts.1ch.15.28: And all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of Jehovah with shouting, and with sound of the trumpet, and with clarions, and with cymbals, playing aloud with lutes and harps.
texts.1ch.15.29: And it came to pass as the ark of the covenant of Jehovah came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looked through a window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.
texts.1ch.16.1: And they brought in the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had spread for it; and they presented burnt-offerings and peace-offerings before God.
texts.1ch.16.2: And when David had ended offering up the burnt-offerings and the peace-offerings, he blessed the people in the name of Jehovah.
texts.1ch.16.3: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread and a measure [of wine] and a raisin-cake.
texts.1ch.16.4: And he appointed certain of the Levites to do the service before the ark of Jehovah, and to celebrate, and to thank and praise Jehovah the God of Israel:
texts.1ch.16.5: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah and Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with instruments of lutes and with harps; and Asaph sounding with cymbals;
texts.1ch.16.6: and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.
texts.1ch.16.7: Then on that day David delivered first [this psalm] to give thanks to Jehovah through Asaph and his brethren.
texts.1ch.16.8: Give thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name; Make known his acts among the peoples.
texts.1ch.16.9: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him; Meditate upon all his wondrous works.
texts.1ch.16.10: Glory in his holy name: Let the heart of them rejoice that seek Jehovah.
texts.1ch.16.11: Seek Jehovah and his strength, Seek his face continually;
texts.1ch.16.12: Remember his wondrous works which he hath done; His miracles, and the judgments of his mouth:
texts.1ch.16.13: Ye seed of Israel his servant, Ye sons of Jacob, his chosen ones.
texts.1ch.16.14: He, Jehovah, is our God; His judgments are in all the earth.
texts.1ch.16.15: Be ye ever mindful of his covenant, The word which he commanded to a thousand generations, --
texts.1ch.16.16: Which he made with Abraham, And of his oath unto Isaac;
texts.1ch.16.17: And he confirmed it unto Jacob for a statute, Unto Israel for an everlasting covenant,
texts.1ch.16.18: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance;
texts.1ch.16.19: When ye were a few men in number, Of small account, and strangers in it.
texts.1ch.16.20: And they went from nation to nation, And from one kingdom to another people.
texts.1ch.16.21: He suffered no man to oppress them, And reproved kings for their sakes,
texts.1ch.16.22: [Saying,] Touch not mine anointed ones, And do my prophets no harm.
texts.1ch.16.23: Sing unto Jehovah, all the earth; Publish his salvation from day to day.
texts.1ch.16.24: Declare his glory among the nations, His wondrous works among all peoples.
texts.1ch.16.25: For Jehovah is great, and exceedingly to be praised; And he is terrible above all gods.
texts.1ch.16.26: For all the gods of the peoples are idols; But Jehovah made the heavens.
texts.1ch.16.27: Majesty and splendour are before him; Strength and gladness in his place.
texts.1ch.16.28: Give unto Jehovah, ye families of peoples, Give unto Jehovah glory and strength!
texts.1ch.16.29: Give unto Jehovah the glory of his name! Bring an oblation, and come before him: Worship Jehovah in holy splendour.
texts.1ch.16.30: Tremble before him, all the earth: The world also is established, it shall not be moved.
texts.1ch.16.31: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; And let them say among the nations, Jehovah reigneth!
texts.1ch.16.32: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; Let the field exult, and all that is therein.
texts.1ch.16.33: Then shall the trees of the forest sing out at the presence of Jehovah, For he cometh to judge the earth.
texts.1ch.16.34: Give thanks unto Jehovah, for he is good; For his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.
texts.1ch.16.35: And say, Save us, O God of our salvation, And gather us, and deliver us from the nations, To give thanks unto thy holy name, To triumph in thy praise.
texts.1ch.16.36: Blessed be Jehovah the God of Israel, from eternity and to eternity! And all the people said, Amen! and praised Jehovah.
texts.1ch.16.37: And he left there, before the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, Asaph and his brethren, to do the service before the ark continually, as every day's duty required;
texts.1ch.16.38: and Obed-Edom, and their brethren, sixty-eight; Obed-Edom also, the son of Jeduthun, and Hosah as doorkeepers.
texts.1ch.16.39: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of Jehovah in the high place that was at Gibeon,
texts.1ch.16.40: to offer up burnt-offerings to Jehovah on the altar of burnt-offering continually, morning and evening, and according to all that is written in the law of Jehovah, which he commanded Israel;
texts.1ch.16.41: and with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to Jehovah, because his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;
texts.1ch.16.42: and with them, [with] Heman and Jeduthun, trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud; and the musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were at the gate.
texts.1ch.16.43: And all the people departed every one to his house; and David returned to bless his household.
texts.1ch.17.1: And it came to pass as David dwelt in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Behold, I dwell in a house of cedars, and the ark of the covenant of Jehovah under curtains.
texts.1ch.17.2: And Nathan said to David, Do all that is in thy heart; for God is with thee.
texts.1ch.17.3: And it came to pass that night that the word of God came to Nathan saying,
texts.1ch.17.4: Go and say to David my servant, Thus saith Jehovah: Thou shalt not build me a house to dwell in;
texts.1ch.17.5: for I have not dwelt in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day; but I have been from tent to tent, and from [one] tabernacle [to another].
texts.1ch.17.6: In all my going about with all Israel, did I speak a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why build ye me not a house of cedars?
texts.1ch.17.7: And now, thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: I took thee from the pasture-grounds, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel;
texts.1ch.17.8: and I have been with thee whithersoever thou wentest, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name, like unto the name of the great men that are on the earth.
texts.1ch.17.9: And I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own, and be disturbed no more; neither shall the sons of wickedness waste them any more, as formerly,
texts.1ch.17.10: and since the days that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. And I will subdue all thine enemies; and I tell thee that Jehovah will build thee a house.
texts.1ch.17.11: And it shall come to pass, when thy days are fulfilled that thou must go [to be] with thy fathers, that I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
texts.1ch.17.12: It is he who shall build me a house, and I will establish his throne for ever.
texts.1ch.17.13: I will be his father, and he shall be my son; and I will not take away my mercy from him, as I took it from him that was before thee;
texts.1ch.17.14: and I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom for ever; and his throne shall be established for ever.
texts.1ch.17.15: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak to David.
texts.1ch.17.16: And king David went in and sat before Jehovah, and said, Who am I, Jehovah Elohim, and what is my house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
texts.1ch.17.17: And this hath been a small thing in thy sight, O God; and thou hast spoken of thy servant's house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the rank of a man of high degree, Jehovah Elohim.
texts.1ch.17.18: What can David [say] more to thee for the glory of thy servant? thou indeed knowest thy servant.
texts.1ch.17.19: Jehovah, for thy servant's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.
texts.1ch.17.20: Jehovah, there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
texts.1ch.17.21: And who is like thy people Israel, the one nation in the earth that God went to redeem to be a people to himself, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, which thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?
texts.1ch.17.22: And thy people Israel hast thou made thine own people for ever; and thou, Jehovah, art become their God.
texts.1ch.17.23: And now, Jehovah, let the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.
texts.1ch.17.24: Let it even be established, and let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, is God to Israel; and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.
texts.1ch.17.25: For thou, my God, hast revealed to thy servant that thou wilt build him a house; therefore hath thy servant found [in his heart] to pray before thee.
texts.1ch.17.26: And now, Jehovah, thou art that God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant;
texts.1ch.17.27: and now, let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever; for thou, Jehovah, hast blessed [it], and it shall be blessed for ever.
texts.1ch.18.1: And after this it came to pass that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
texts.1ch.18.2: And he smote the Moabites; and the Moabites became David's servants, [and] brought gifts.
texts.1ch.18.3: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah, at Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
texts.1ch.18.4: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David houghed all the chariot [horses], but reserved of them [for] a hundred chariots.
texts.1ch.18.5: And the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, and David smote of the Syrians twenty-two thousand men.
texts.1ch.18.6: And David put [garrisons] in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, [and] brought gifts. And Jehovah preserved David whithersoever he went.
texts.1ch.18.7: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
texts.1ch.18.8: And from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, David took very much brass, of which Solomon made the brazen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
texts.1ch.18.9: And Tou king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the forces of Hadarezer king of Zobah;
texts.1ch.18.10: and he sent Hadoram his son to king David to inquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer and smitten him; for Hadarezer was continually at war with Tou; [he sent] also all manner of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.
texts.1ch.18.11: Them also king David dedicated to Jehovah, with the silver and the gold that he had brought from all the nations: from the Edomites, and from the Moabites, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from the Amalekites.
texts.1ch.18.12: And Abishai the son of Zeruiah smote of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.
texts.1ch.18.13: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all they of Edom became servants to David. And Jehovah preserved David whithersoever he went.
texts.1ch.18.14: And David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice to all his people.
texts.1ch.18.15: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was chronicler;
texts.1ch.18.16: and Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
texts.1ch.18.17: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were the first at the king's hand.
texts.1ch.19.1: And it came to pass after this that Nahash king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.
texts.1ch.19.2: And David said, I will shew kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And David's servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.
texts.1ch.19.3: And the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Is it, in thine eyes, to honour thy father that David has sent comforters to thee? Is it not to search and overthrow, and to spy out the land that his servants are come to thee?
texts.1ch.19.4: And Hanun took David's servants, and had them shaved, and their raiment cut off in the midst, as far as the hip, and sent them away.
texts.1ch.19.5: And [certain] went and told David concerning the men; and he sent to meet them, for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Abide at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.
texts.1ch.19.6: And the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David; and Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and from the Syrians of Maacah, and from Zobah.
texts.1ch.19.7: And they hired thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah and his people; and they came and encamped before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered together from their cities, and came to battle.
texts.1ch.19.8: And David heard [of it], and he sent Joab, and all the host, the mighty men.
texts.1ch.19.9: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entrance of the city; and the kings that had come were by themselves on the field.
texts.1ch.19.10: And Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind; and he chose out of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians;
texts.1ch.19.11: and the rest of the people he gave into the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
texts.1ch.19.12: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me; and if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.
texts.1ch.19.13: Be strong, and let us shew ourselves valiant for our people, and for the cities of our God; and Jehovah will do what is good in his sight.
texts.1ch.19.14: And Joab and the people that were with him drew near in front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.
texts.1ch.19.15: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. And Joab came to Jerusalem.
texts.1ch.19.16: And when the Syrians saw that they were routed before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river; and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer [went] before them.
texts.1ch.19.17: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over the Jordan, and came upon them, and set [the battle] in array against them. And David put the battle in array against the Syrians, and they fought with him.
texts.1ch.19.18: And the Syrians fled from before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand [in] chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and slew Shophach the captain of the host.
texts.1ch.19.19: And the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were routed before Israel, and they made peace with David, and became his servants. And the Syrians would no more help the children of Ammon.
texts.1ch.20.1: And it came to pass at the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go forth, that Joab led forth the power of the army, and laid waste the land of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David abode at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and overthrew it.
texts.1ch.20.2: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was [set] upon David's head: and he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance.
texts.1ch.20.3: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with the saw, and with harrows of iron, and with saws. And so David did to all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
texts.1ch.20.4: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; then Sibbechai the Hushathite smote Sippai, one of the children of Rapha; and they were subdued.
texts.1ch.20.5: And there was again a battle with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair smote Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite; now the shaft of his spear was like a weaver's beam.
texts.1ch.20.6: And there was again a battle, at Gath; and there was a man [there] of great stature, whose fingers [and toes] were four and twenty, six [on each hand], and six [on each foot]; and he also was born to Rapha.
texts.1ch.20.7: And he defied Israel; but Jonathan the son of Shimea David's brother smote him.
texts.1ch.20.8: These were born to Rapha in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
texts.1ch.21.1: And Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to number Israel.
texts.1ch.21.2: And David said to Joab and to the princes of the people, Go, number Israel from Beer-sheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know it.
texts.1ch.21.3: And Joab said, Jehovah add to his people, how many soever they be, a hundredfold: are they not all, my lord O king, my lord's servants? why does my lord require this thing? why should he become a trespass to Israel?
texts.1ch.21.4: But the king's word prevailed against Joab; and Joab departed, and went through all Israel, and came [again] to Jerusalem.
texts.1ch.21.5: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people to David. And all they of Israel were eleven hundred thousand men that drew sword; and of Judah, four hundred and seventy thousand men that drew sword.
texts.1ch.21.6: But Levi and Benjamin he did not count among them; for the king's word was abominable to Joab.
texts.1ch.21.7: And God was displeased on account of this thing, and he smote Israel.
texts.1ch.21.8: And David said to God, I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing; and now, I beseech thee, put away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
texts.1ch.21.9: And Jehovah spoke to Gad, David's seer, saying,
texts.1ch.21.10: Go and speak to David saying, Thus saith Jehovah: I offer thee three [things]; choose one of them, that I may do it unto thee.
texts.1ch.21.11: And Gad came to David, and said to him, Thus saith Jehovah:
texts.1ch.21.12: Choose thee, either three years of famine, or three months to be destroyed before thine adversaries while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee, or three days the sword of Jehovah and the pestilence in the land, and the angel of Jehovah destroying through all the borders of Israel. And now consider what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.
texts.1ch.21.13: And David said to Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall, I pray thee, into the hand of Jehovah, for his mercies are very great; but let me not fall into the hand of man.
texts.1ch.21.14: And Jehovah sent a pestilence upon Israel; and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.
texts.1ch.21.15: And God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it; and as he was destroying, Jehovah beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough; withdraw now thine hand. And the angel of Jehovah stood by the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
texts.1ch.21.16: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of Jehovah stand between the earth and the heavens, and his sword drawn in his hand, stretched out over Jerusalem. And David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.
texts.1ch.21.17: And David said to God, Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? It is I that have sinned and done evil; but these sheep, what have they done? Let thy hand, I pray thee, Jehovah my God, be on me and on my father's house; but not on thy people, that they should be smitten.
texts.1ch.21.18: And the angel of Jehovah commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up and rear an altar to Jehovah in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
texts.1ch.21.19: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he had spoken in the name of Jehovah.
texts.1ch.21.20: And Ornan turned back and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
texts.1ch.21.21: And David came to Ornan, and Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing-floor, and bowed himself to David with [his] face to the ground.
texts.1ch.21.22: And David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of the threshing-floor, that I may build an altar in it to Jehovah: grant it to me for the full money, that the plague may be stayed from the people.
texts.1ch.21.23: And Ornan said to David, Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his sight: see, I give the oxen for the burnt-offering, and the threshing-sledges for wood, and the wheat for the oblation; I give it all.
texts.1ch.21.24: And king David said to Ornan, No; but I will in any case buy [them] for the full money; for I will not take that which is thine for Jehovah, to offer up a burnt-offering without cost.
texts.1ch.21.25: And David gave to Ornan for the place in shekels of gold the weight of six hundred [shekels].
texts.1ch.21.26: And David built there an altar to Jehovah, and offered up burnt-offerings and peace-offerings, and called upon Jehovah; and he answered him from the heavens by fire upon the altar of burnt-offering.
texts.1ch.21.27: And Jehovah spoke to the angel; and he put up his sword again into its sheath.
texts.1ch.21.28: At that time when David saw that Jehovah had answered him in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
texts.1ch.21.29: And the tabernacle of Jehovah, which Moses had made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt-offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.
texts.1ch.21.30: But David could not go before it to inquire of God; for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of Jehovah.
texts.1ch.22.1: And David said, This is the house of Jehovah Elohim, and this is the altar of burnt-offering for Israel.
texts.1ch.22.2: And David commanded to collect the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.
texts.1ch.22.3: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joists, and brass in abundance without weight;
texts.1ch.22.4: and cedar-trees innumerable; for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought cedar-wood in abundance to David.
texts.1ch.22.5: For David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for Jehovah must be exceeding great in fame and in beauty in all lands: I will therefore make preparation for it. And David prepared abundantly before his death.
texts.1ch.22.6: And he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build a house for Jehovah the God of Israel.
texts.1ch.22.7: And David said to Solomon, As for me, my son, I was minded to build a house unto the name of Jehovah my God.
texts.1ch.22.8: But the word of Jehovah came to me saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build a house unto my name, for thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.
texts.1ch.22.9: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about; for his name shall be Solomon, and in his days I will give peace and quietness unto Israel.
texts.1ch.22.10: He shall build a house unto my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.
texts.1ch.22.11: Now, my son, Jehovah be with thee, that thou mayest prosper, and build the house of Jehovah thy God, as he has said of thee.
texts.1ch.22.12: Only, Jehovah give thee wisdom and understanding, and place thee over Israel, and to keep the law of Jehovah thy God.
texts.1ch.22.13: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to perform the statutes and ordinances which Jehovah commanded Moses for Israel: be strong and courageous; fear not, neither be dismayed.
texts.1ch.22.14: And behold, in my affliction I have prepared for the house of Jehovah a hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight, for it is in abundance; and timber and stone have I prepared; and thou shalt add to it.
texts.1ch.22.15: And there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of skilful men for every kind of work.
texts.1ch.22.16: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing and Jehovah be with thee.
texts.1ch.22.17: And David commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, [saying,]
texts.1ch.22.18: Is not Jehovah your God with you? and has he [not] given you rest on every side? for he has given the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before Jehovah, and before his people.
texts.1ch.22.19: Now set your heart and your soul to seek Jehovah your God; and arise and build the sanctuary of Jehovah Elohim, to bring the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, and the vessels of the sanctuary of God into the house that is to be built unto the name of Jehovah.
texts.1ch.23.1: And David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
texts.1ch.23.2: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
texts.1ch.23.3: And the Levites were numbered from thirty years old and upward; and their number, by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.
texts.1ch.23.4: Of these, twenty-four thousand were to preside over the work of the house of Jehovah; and six thousand were officers and judges;
texts.1ch.23.5: and four thousand were doorkeepers; and four thousand praised Jehovah with the instruments which I made, [said David,] to praise [therewith].
texts.1ch.23.6: And David divided them into courses according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
texts.1ch.23.7: Of the Gershonites: Laadan and Shimei.
texts.1ch.23.8: The sons of Laadan: the head was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
texts.1ch.23.9: The sons of Shimei: Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the chief fathers of Laadan.
texts.1ch.23.10: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Ziza, and Jeush, and Beriah. These were the four sons of Shimei.
texts.1ch.23.11: And Jahath was the head, and Ziza the second; and Jeush and Beriah had not many sons: as father's house, therefore, they were reckoned as one.
texts.1ch.23.12: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Jizhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
texts.1ch.23.13: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. And Aaron was separated, that he should be hallowed as most holy, he and his sons for ever, to offer before Jehovah, to do service to him, and to bless in his name for ever.
texts.1ch.23.14: -- And as to Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.
texts.1ch.23.15: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
texts.1ch.23.16: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the head.
texts.1ch.23.17: And the sons of Eliezer: Rehabiah the head; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
texts.1ch.23.18: -- The sons of Jizhar: Shelomith the head.
texts.1ch.23.19: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the head, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
texts.1ch.23.20: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the head, and Jishijah the second.
texts.1ch.23.21: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
texts.1ch.23.22: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters; and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.
texts.1ch.23.23: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
texts.1ch.23.24: These were the sons of Levi according to their fathers' houses, the chief fathers, as they were reckoned, by number of names by their polls, who did the work of the service of the house of Jehovah, from twenty years old and upward.
texts.1ch.23.25: For David said, Jehovah the God of Israel has given rest to his people, and he will dwell in Jerusalem for ever;
texts.1ch.23.26: and the Levites also have no more to carry the tabernacle, nor any of its vessels for its service.
texts.1ch.23.27: For by the last words of David was this [done], -- the numbering of the sons of Levi from twenty years old and upward.
texts.1ch.23.28: For their place was by the side of the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of Jehovah, over the courts, and over the chambers, and over the purifying of all holy things, and [for] the work of the service of the house of God;
texts.1ch.23.29: and for the loaves to be set in rows, and for the fine flour for the oblation, and for the unleavened cakes, and for [what is baked in] the pan, and for that which is saturated [with oil], and for all measure of capacity and size;
texts.1ch.23.30: and to stand every morning to thank and praise Jehovah, and likewise at even;
texts.1ch.23.31: and for all burnt-offerings offered up to Jehovah on the sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the ordinance concerning them, continually, before Jehovah;
texts.1ch.23.32: and they kept the charge of the tent of meeting, and the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of Jehovah.
texts.1ch.24.1: And the divisions of the sons of Aaron: the sons of Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
texts.1ch.24.2: And Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; and Eleazar and Ithamar exercised the priesthood.
texts.1ch.24.3: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their office in their service.
texts.1ch.24.4: And there were more head-men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar, and [thus] were they divided: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen heads of fathers' houses, and eight of the sons of Ithamar according to their fathers' houses.
texts.1ch.24.5: And they were divided by lot, one with another; for the princes of the sanctuary and the princes of God were of the sons of Eleazar and of the sons of Ithamar.
texts.1ch.24.6: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, [one] of the Levites, inscribed them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the chief fathers of the priests and Levites: one father's house was drawn for Eleazar, and one drawn for Ithamar.
texts.1ch.24.7: And the first lot came forth for Jehoiarib, the second for Jedaiah,
texts.1ch.24.8: the third for Harim, the fourth for Seorim,
texts.1ch.24.9: the fifth for Malchijah, the sixth for Mijamin,
texts.1ch.24.10: the seventh for Hakkoz, the eighth for Abijah,
texts.1ch.24.11: the ninth for Jeshuah, the tenth for Shecaniah,
texts.1ch.24.12: the eleventh for Eliashib, the twelfth for Jakim,
texts.1ch.24.13: the thirteenth for Huppah, the fourteenth for Jeshebeab,
texts.1ch.24.14: the fifteenth for Bilgah, the sixteenth for Immer,
texts.1ch.24.15: the seventeenth for Hezir, the eighteenth for Happizez,
texts.1ch.24.16: the nineteenth for Pethahiah, the twentieth for Ezekiel,
texts.1ch.24.17: the twenty-first for Jachin, the twenty-second for Gamul,
texts.1ch.24.18: the twenty-third for Delaiah, the twenty-fourth for Maaziah.
texts.1ch.24.19: This is their ordering in their service to come into the house of Jehovah, according to their ordinance, through Aaron their father, as Jehovah the God of Israel had commanded him.
texts.1ch.24.20: And as for the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
texts.1ch.24.21: Of Rehabiah, of the sons of Rehabiah, the head was Jishijah.
texts.1ch.24.22: Of the Jizharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
texts.1ch.24.23: -- And the sons [of Hebron]: Jerijah [the head], Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
texts.1ch.24.24: The sons of Uzziel, Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir;
texts.1ch.24.25: the brother of Micah was Jishijah; of the sons of Jishijah, Zechariah.
texts.1ch.24.26: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Jaaziah, his son.
texts.1ch.24.27: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah his son: Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
texts.1ch.24.28: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
texts.1ch.24.29: Of Kish, the sons of Kish: Jerahmeel.
texts.1ch.24.30: And the sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites according to their fathers' houses.
texts.1ch.24.31: These likewise cast lots just as their brethren the sons of Aaron before David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief fathers of the priests and Levites, -- the chief fathers just as the youngest of their brethren.
texts.1ch.25.1: And David and the captains of the host separated for the service those of the sons of Asaph and of Heman and of Jeduthun who were to prophesy with harps and lutes and cymbals; and the number of the men employed according to their service was:
texts.1ch.25.2: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asharelah, the sons of Asaph under the direction of Asaph, who prophesied at the direction of the king.
texts.1ch.25.3: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Isaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, [and Shimei] six, under the direction of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with the harp, to give thanks and to praise Jehovah.
texts.1ch.25.4: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkijah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth:
texts.1ch.25.5: all these were sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to exalt his power; and God had given to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
texts.1ch.25.6: All these were under the direction of their fathers Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman, for song in the house of Jehovah, with cymbals, lutes and harps, for the service of the house of God, under the direction of the king.
texts.1ch.25.7: And the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of Jehovah, all of them skilful, was two hundred and eighty-eight.
texts.1ch.25.8: And they cast lots with one another over the charges, the small as well as the great, the teacher with the scholar.
texts.1ch.25.9: And the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph; to Gedaliah the second: he and his brethren and his sons were twelve.
texts.1ch.25.10: The third to Zaccur; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.25.11: The fourth to Jizri; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.25.12: The fifth to Nethaniah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.25.13: The sixth to Bukkijah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.25.14: The seventh to Jesharelah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.25.15: The eighth to Isaiah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.25.16: The ninth to Mattaniah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.25.17: The tenth to Shimei; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.25.18: The eleventh to Azareel; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.25.19: The twelfth to Hashabiah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.25.20: The thirteenth to Shubael; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.25.21: The fourteenth to Mattithiah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.25.22: The fifteenth to Jeremoth; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.25.23: The sixteenth to Hananiah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.25.24: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.25.25: The eighteenth to Hanani; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.25.26: The nineteenth to Mallothi; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.25.27: The twentieth to Elijathah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.25.28: The twenty-first to Hothir; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.25.29: The twenty-second to Giddalti; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.25.30: The twenty-third to Mahazioth; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.25.31: The twenty-fourth to Romamti-ezer; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
texts.1ch.26.1: The divisions of the doorkeepers. Of the Korahites: Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
texts.1ch.26.2: And Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
texts.1ch.26.3: Elam the fifth, Johanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.
texts.1ch.26.4: -- And the sons of Obed-Edom: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,
texts.1ch.26.5: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God had blessed him.
texts.1ch.26.6: And to Shemaiah his son were sons born, who were rulers in their father's house; for they were mighty men of valour.
texts.1ch.26.7: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, [and] Elzabad, whose brethren were valiant men, Elihu and Semachiah.
texts.1ch.26.8: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men in strength for the service, were sixty-two of Obed-Edom.
texts.1ch.26.9: -- And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, men of valour, eighteen.
texts.1ch.26.10: -- And Hosah, of the sons of Merari, had sons: Shimri the head, for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the head;
texts.1ch.26.11: Hilkijah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.
texts.1ch.26.12: Among these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, among the head-men, as to the charges together with their brethren, for performing the service in the house of Jehovah.
texts.1ch.26.13: And they cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers' houses, for every gate.
texts.1ch.26.14: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah; and they cast lots for Zechariah his son, a wise counsellor, and his lot came out northward;
texts.1ch.26.15: to Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.
texts.1ch.26.16: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the ascent, watch against watch.
texts.1ch.26.17: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and in the storehouse two [and] two.
texts.1ch.26.18: At the portico westward, four at the causeway, two at the portico.
texts.1ch.26.19: These are the divisions of the doorkeepers among the sons of the Korahites and among the sons of Merari.
texts.1ch.26.20: And the Levites: Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
texts.1ch.26.21: The sons of Laadan, the sons of the Gershonites of Laadan, chief fathers of Laadan the Gershonite: Jehieli;
texts.1ch.26.22: the sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of the house of Jehovah.
texts.1ch.26.23: As to the Amramites, the Jizharites, the Hebronites, the Uzzielites....
texts.1ch.26.24: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was overseer of the treasures.
texts.1ch.26.25: And his brethren, of Eliezer: Rehabiah his son, and Isaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
texts.1ch.26.26: This Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which king David, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated
texts.1ch.26.27: (from the wars and out of the spoils had they dedicated [them], to maintain the house of Jehovah),
texts.1ch.26.28: and all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated: all that was dedicated was under the hand of Shelomith and of his brethren.
texts.1ch.26.29: Of the Jizharites, Chenaniah and his sons were over Israel, for the outward business for officers and judges.
texts.1ch.26.30: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, for the administration of Israel on this side Jordan westward, for all the business of Jehovah, and for the service of the king.
texts.1ch.26.31: Of the Hebronites was Jerijah the head; (as to the Hebronites, according to their families according to the fathers: in the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jaazer in Gilead;)
texts.1ch.26.32: and his brethren, men of valour, two thousand seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God, and the affairs of the king.
texts.1ch.27.1: And [these] are the children of Israel after their number, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in every matter of the divisions, which came in and went out month by month throughout the months of the year; in every division were twenty-four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.2: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.3: He was of the children of Pherez, the head of all the captains of the hosts for the first month.
texts.1ch.27.4: And over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite; and in his division was Mikloth ruler; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.5: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah (the son of Jehoiada, a principal officer): [he was] head; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.6: This Benaiah was a mighty man among the thirty, and above the thirty; and in his division was Ammizabad his son.
texts.1ch.27.7: The fourth for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.8: The fifth for the fifth month was the captain Shamhuth the Jizrahite; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.9: The sixth for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.10: The seventh for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.11: The eighth for the eighth month was Sibbechai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.12: The ninth for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjaminites; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.13: The tenth for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.14: The eleventh for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.15: The twelfth for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
texts.1ch.27.16: And over the tribes of Israel were: for the Reubenites Eliezer the son of Zichri was the prince; for the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah;
texts.1ch.27.17: for the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; for Aaron, Zadok;
texts.1ch.27.18: for Judah, Elihu of the brethren of David; for Issachar, Omri the son of Michael;
texts.1ch.27.19: for Zebulun, Jishmaiah the son of Obadiah; for Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel;
texts.1ch.27.20: for the children of Ephraim, Hosea the son of Azaziah; for the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;
texts.1ch.27.21: for the half [tribe] of Manasseh in Gilead, Jiddo the son of Zechariah; for Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner;
texts.1ch.27.22: for Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Israel.
texts.1ch.27.23: And David took not their number from twenty years old and under; for Jehovah had said he would increase Israel as the stars of heaven.
texts.1ch.27.24: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he did not finish; and there fell wrath for it upon Israel; and the number was not put in the account of the chronicles of king David.
texts.1ch.27.25: And over the king's treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel; and over the storehouses in the country, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the towers was Jonathan the son of Uzziah.
texts.1ch.27.26: And over them that worked in the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub.
texts.1ch.27.27: And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite; and over what was in the vineyards of stores of wine was Zabdi the Shiphmite:
texts.1ch.27.28: and over the olive-trees and the sycamore-trees that were in the lowland was Baal-hanan the Gederite; and over the cellars of oil was Joash.
texts.1ch.27.29: And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite; and over the herds in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai.
texts.1ch.27.30: And over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite; and over the asses was Jehdiah the Meronothite.
texts.1ch.27.31: And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagarite. All these were comptrollers of the substance which was king David's.
texts.1ch.27.32: And Jonathan, David's uncle, was counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe; and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king's sons;
texts.1ch.27.33: and Ahithophel was the king's counsellor; and Hushai the Archite was the king's friend;
texts.1ch.27.34: and after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar; and Joab was captain of the king's army.
texts.1ch.28.1: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the princes of the divisions that ministered to the king, and the captains over thousands, and the captains over hundreds, and the comptrollers of all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the chamberlains, and the mighty men, and all the men of valour, unto Jerusalem.
texts.1ch.28.2: And king David stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren and my people! I had in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of Jehovah and for the footstool of our God, and I have prepared to build.
texts.1ch.28.3: But God said to me, Thou shalt not build a house unto my name, for thou art a man of war, and hast shed blood.
texts.1ch.28.4: And Jehovah the God of Israel chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever; for he has chosen Judah to be the prince; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel;
texts.1ch.28.5: and of all my sons, (for Jehovah has given me many sons,) he has chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of Jehovah over Israel.
texts.1ch.28.6: And he said to me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
texts.1ch.28.7: And I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be firm to do my commandments and mine ordinances, as at this day.
texts.1ch.28.8: And now in the sight of all Israel, the congregation of Jehovah, and in the audience of our God, -- keep and seek for all the commandments of Jehovah your God; that ye may possess the good land, and leave it as an inheritance to your children after you for ever.
texts.1ch.28.9: And thou, Solomon my son, know the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for Jehovah searches all hearts, and discerns all the imaginations of the thoughts. If thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cut thee off for ever.
texts.1ch.28.10: Consider now, that Jehovah has chosen thee to build a house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do [it].
texts.1ch.28.11: And David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of its houses, and of its treasuries, and of its upper chambers, and of its inner chambers, and of the house of the mercy-seat;
texts.1ch.28.12: and the pattern of all that he had by the Spirit, of the courts of the house of Jehovah, and of all the chambers round about, for the treasuries of the house of God, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;
texts.1ch.28.13: and for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of Jehovah, and for all the instruments of service in the house of Jehovah:
texts.1ch.28.14: gold by weight for [things] of gold, for all utensils of each kind of service; for all utensils of silver, by weight, for all utensils of each kind of service;
texts.1ch.28.15: and the weight of the golden candlesticks, and of their golden lamps, by weight for every candlestick, and for its lamps; and for the silver candlesticks, by weight, for the candlestick and for its lamps, according to the use of every candlestick;
texts.1ch.28.16: and gold by weight for the tables of the [loaves] to be set in rows, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver;
texts.1ch.28.17: and pure gold for the forks, and the bowls, and the goblets; and for the golden basons by weight for every bason; and for the silver basons by weight for every bason;
texts.1ch.28.18: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and the pattern of the chariot of the cherubim of gold, which spread out [their wings] and cover the ark of the covenant of Jehovah.
texts.1ch.28.19: All this [said David,] in writing, by Jehovah's hand upon me, instructing as to all the works of the pattern.
texts.1ch.28.20: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and courageous, and do it; fear not nor be dismayed: for Jehovah Elohim, my God, will be with thee; he will not leave thee, neither forsake thee, until all the work for the service of the house of Jehovah is finished.
texts.1ch.28.21: And behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites are for all the service of the house of God; and thou hast with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing man, skilful for every sort of service; and the princes and all the people are wholly at thy commandment.
texts.1ch.29.1: And king David said to all the congregation, Solomon my son, the one whom God has chosen, is young and tender, and the work is great; for this palace is not to be for man, but for Jehovah Elohim.
texts.1ch.29.2: And I have prepared according to all my power for the house of my God gold for [things of] gold, and silver for [things of] silver, and brass for [things of] brass, iron for [things of] iron, and wood for [things of] wood; onyx stones, and [stones] to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and white marble in abundance.
texts.1ch.29.3: And moreover, in my affection for the house of my God I have given of my own property of gold and silver, for the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the house of the sanctuary:
texts.1ch.29.4: three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses;
texts.1ch.29.5: gold for [things of] gold, and silver for [things of] silver, and for all manner of work by the hands of artificers. And who is willing to offer to Jehovah this day?
texts.1ch.29.6: And the chief fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and the comptrollers of the king's business, offered willingly.
texts.1ch.29.7: And they gave for the service of the house of God five thousand talents and ten thousand darics of gold, and ten thousand talents of silver, and eighteen thousand talents of brass, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.
texts.1ch.29.8: And they with whom stones were found gave [them] to the treasure of the house of Jehovah, into the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
texts.1ch.29.9: And the people rejoiced because they offered willingly, for with perfect heart they offered willingly to Jehovah; and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.
texts.1ch.29.10: And David blessed Jehovah in the sight of all the congregation; and David said, Blessed be thou, Jehovah, the God of our father Israel, for ever and ever.
texts.1ch.29.11: Thine, Jehovah, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the splendour, and the majesty; for all that is in the heavens and on the earth is thine: thine, Jehovah, is the kingdom, and thou art exalted as Head above all;
texts.1ch.29.12: and riches and glory are of thee, and thou rulest over everything; and in thy hand is power and might; and in thy hand it is to make all great and strong.
texts.1ch.29.13: And now, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.
texts.1ch.29.14: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer willingly after this manner? for all is of thee, and of that which is from thy hand have we given thee.
texts.1ch.29.15: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no hope [of life].
texts.1ch.29.16: Jehovah our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee a house to thy holy name, is of thy hand, and is all thine own.
texts.1ch.29.17: And I know, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. In the uprightness of my heart have I willingly offered all these things; and now have I seen with joy thy people, which are present here, offer willingly to thee.
texts.1ch.29.18: Jehovah, God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and direct their hearts to thee!
texts.1ch.29.19: And give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision.
texts.1ch.29.20: And David said to all the congregation, Bless now Jehovah your God. And all the congregation blessed Jehovah the God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and did homage to Jehovah and the king.
texts.1ch.29.21: And they sacrificed sacrifices to Jehovah, and offered up burnt-offerings to Jehovah, on the morrow after that day: a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, a thousand lambs, with their drink-offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.
texts.1ch.29.22: And they ate and drank before Jehovah on that day with great joy. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him to Jehovah to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.
texts.1ch.29.23: And Solomon sat on the throne of Jehovah as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
texts.1ch.29.24: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves to Solomon the king.
texts.1ch.29.25: And Jehovah magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him royal majesty such as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
texts.1ch.29.26: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
texts.1ch.29.27: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years: he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
texts.1ch.29.28: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour; and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.
texts.1ch.29.29: And the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer;
texts.1ch.29.30: with all his reign and his might, and the times that passed over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.

texts.1ch.1.5: Sons of Japheth: Gomer and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
texts.1ch.1.6: And sons of Gomer: Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
texts.1ch.1.7: And sons of Javan: Elisha, and Tarshishah, Kittim, and Dodanim.
texts.1ch.1.8: Sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
texts.1ch.1.9: And sons of Cush: Seba and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecka. And sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
texts.1ch.1.10: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the land.
texts.1ch.1.11: And Mizraim begat the Ludim, and the Anamim, and the Lehabim, and the Naphtuhim,
texts.1ch.1.12: and the Pathrusim, and the Casluhim (from whom came out the Philistim), and the Caphtorim.
texts.1ch.1.13: And Canaan begat Zidon his first born, and Heth,
texts.1ch.1.14: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
texts.1ch.1.15: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
texts.1ch.1.16: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
texts.1ch.1.17: Sons of Shem: Elam and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.
texts.1ch.1.18: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.
texts.1ch.1.19: And to Eber have been born two sons, the name of the one [is] Peleg, for in his days hath the land been divided, and the name of his brother is Joktan.
texts.1ch.1.20: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
texts.1ch.1.21: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
texts.1ch.1.22: and Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
texts.1ch.1.23: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab; all these [are] sons of Joktan.
texts.1ch.1.28: Sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
texts.1ch.1.29: These [are] their generations: first-born of Ishmael, Nebaioth, and Kedar, and Adheel, and Mibsam,
texts.1ch.1.30: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,
texts.1ch.1.31: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedema. These are sons of Ishmael.
texts.1ch.1.32: And sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
texts.1ch.1.33: And sons of Midian: Ephah and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah; all these [are] sons of Keturah.
texts.1ch.1.34: And Abraham begetteth Isaac. Sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
texts.1ch.1.35: Sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
texts.1ch.1.36: Sons of Eliphaz: Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
texts.1ch.1.37: Sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
texts.1ch.1.38: And sons of Seir: Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezar, and Dishan.
texts.1ch.1.39: And sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam, and sister of Lotan [is] Timna.
texts.1ch.1.40: Sons of Shobal: Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And sons of Zideon: Aiah and Anah.
texts.1ch.1.41: The sons of Anah: Dishon. and sons of Dishon: Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
texts.1ch.1.42: Sons of Ezer: Bilhan, and Zavan, Jakan. Sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
texts.1ch.1.43: And these [are] the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before the reigning of a king of the sons of Israel: Bela son of Beor, and the name of his city [is] Dinhabah.
texts.1ch.1.44: And Bela dieth, and reign in his stead doth Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrali;
texts.1ch.1.45: and Jobab dieth, and reign in his stead doth Husham from the land of the Temanite;
texts.1ch.1.46: and Husham dieth, and reign in his stead doth Hadad, son of Bedad (who smiteth Midian in the field of Moab) and the name of his city [is] Avith;
texts.1ch.1.47: and Hadad dieth, and reign in his stead doth Samlah from Masrekah;
texts.1ch.1.48: and Samlah dieth, and reign in his stead doth Shaul from Rehoboth of the River;
texts.1ch.1.49: and Shaul dieth, and reign in his stead doth Baal-Hanan son of Achbor;
texts.1ch.1.50: and Baal-Hanan dieth, and reign in his stead doth Hadad, and the name of his city [is] Pai, and the name of his wife [is] Mehetabel daughter of Matred, daughter of Me-Zahab; Hadad also dieth.
texts.1ch.1.51: And chiefs of Edom are: chief Timnah, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,
texts.1ch.1.52: chief Aholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
texts.1ch.1.53: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
texts.1ch.1.54: chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These [are] chiefs of Edom.
texts.1ch.2.1: These [are] sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
texts.1ch.2.2: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
texts.1ch.2.3: Sons of Judah: Er, and Onan, and Shelah, three have been born to him of a daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, first-born of Judah, is evil in the eyes of Jehovah, and He putteth him to death.
texts.1ch.2.4: And Tamar his daughter-in-law hath borne to him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah [are] five.
texts.1ch.2.5: Sons of Pharez: Hezron, and Hamul.
texts.1ch.2.6: And sons of Zerah: Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara; all of them five.
texts.1ch.2.7: And sons of Carmi: Achar, troubler of Israel, who trespassed in the devoted thing.
texts.1ch.2.9: And sons of Hezron who were born to him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
texts.1ch.2.10: And Ram begat Amminadab, and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the sons of Judah;
texts.1ch.2.11: and Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,
texts.1ch.2.12: and Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse;
texts.1ch.2.13: and Jesse begat his first-born Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimea the third,
texts.1ch.2.14: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
texts.1ch.2.15: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh,
texts.1ch.2.16: and their sisters Zeruiah and Abigail. And sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, and Joab, and Asah-El -- three.
texts.1ch.2.17: And Abigail hath borne Amasa, and the father of Amasa [is] Jether the Ishmeelite.
texts.1ch.2.18: And Caleb son of Hezron hath begotten Azubah, Isshah, and Jerioth; and these [are] her sons: Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
texts.1ch.2.19: And Azubah dieth, and Caleb taketh to him Ephrath, and she beareth to him Hur.
texts.1ch.2.20: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.
texts.1ch.2.21: And afterwards hath Hezron gone in unto a daughter of Machir father of Gilead, and he hath taken her, and he [is] a son of sixty years, and she beareth to him Segub.
texts.1ch.2.22: And Segub begat Jair, and he hath twenty and three cities in the land of Gilead,
texts.1ch.2.23: and he taketh Geshur and Aram, the small villages of Jair, from them, with Kenath and its small towns, sixty cities -- all these [belonged to] the sons of Machir father of Gilead.
texts.1ch.2.24: And after the death of Hezron in Caleb-Ephratah, then the wife of Hezron, Abijah, even beareth to him Asshur, father of Tekoa.
texts.1ch.2.25: And sons of Jerahmeel, first-born of Hezron, are: the first-born Ram, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, Ahijah.
texts.1ch.2.26: And Jerahmeel hath another wife, and her name [is] Atarah, she [is] mother of Onam.
texts.1ch.2.27: And sons of Ram, first-born of Jerahmeel, are Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
texts.1ch.2.28: And sons of Onam are Shammai and Jada. And sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
texts.1ch.2.29: And the name of the wife of Abishur [is] Abihail, and she beareth to him Ahban and Molid.
texts.1ch.2.30: And sons of Nadab: Seled, and Appaim; and Seled dieth without sons.
texts.1ch.2.31: And sons of Appaim: Ishi. And sons of Ishi: Sheshan. And sons of Sheshan: Ahlai.
texts.1ch.2.32: And sons of Jada, brother of Shammai: Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether dieth without sons.
texts.1ch.2.33: And sons of Jonathan: Peleth, and Zaza. These were sons of Jerahmeel.
texts.1ch.2.34: And Sheshan had no sons, but daughters, and Sheshan hath a servant, an Egyptian, and his name [is] Jarha,
texts.1ch.2.35: and Sheshan giveth his daughter to Jarha his servant for a wife, and she beareth to him Attai;
texts.1ch.2.36: and Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
texts.1ch.2.37: and Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,
texts.1ch.2.39: and Jehu begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,
texts.1ch.2.40: and Eleasah begat Sismai, and Sismai begat Shallum,
texts.1ch.2.41: and Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.
texts.1ch.2.42: And sons of Caleb brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his first-born, he [is] father of Ziph; and sons of Mareshah: Abi-Hebron.
texts.1ch.2.43: And sons of Hebron: Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
texts.1ch.2.44: And Shema begat Raham father of Jorkoam, and Rekem begat Shammai.
texts.1ch.2.45: And a son of Shammai [is] Maon, and Maon [is] father of Beth-Zur.
texts.1ch.2.46: And Ephah concubine of Caleb bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez; and Haran begat Gazez.
texts.1ch.2.47: And sons of Jahdai: Regem, and Jotham, and Geshem, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
texts.1ch.2.48: The concubine of Caleb, Maachah, bare Sheber and Tirhanah;
texts.1ch.2.49: and she beareth Shaaph father of Madmannah, Sheva father of Machbenah, and father of Gibea; and a daughter of Caleb [is] Achsa.
texts.1ch.2.50: These were sons of Caleb son of Hur, first-born of Ephrathah: Shobal father of Kirjath-Jearim,
texts.1ch.2.51: Salma father of Beth-Lehem, Hareph father of Beth-Gader.
texts.1ch.2.52: And there are sons to Shobal father of Kirjath-Jearim: Haroeh, half of the Menuhothite;
texts.1ch.2.53: and the families of Kirjath-Jearim: the Ithrite, and the Puhite, and the Shumathite, and the Mishraite: from these went out the Zareathite, and the Eshtaulite.
texts.1ch.2.54: Sons of Salma: Beth-Lehem, and the Netophathite, Atroth, Beth-Joab, and half of the Menuhothite, the Zorite;
texts.1ch.2.55: and the families of the scribes the inhabitants of Jabez: Tirathites, Shimeathites, Suchathites. They [are] the Kenites, those coming of Hammath father of the house of Rechab.
texts.1ch.3.1: And these were sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the first-born Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;
texts.1ch.3.2: the third Absalom, son of Maachah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth Adonijah, son of Haggith;
texts.1ch.3.3: the fifth Shephatiah, of Abital; the sixth Ithream, of Eglah his wife.
texts.1ch.3.4: Six have been borne to him in Hebron, and he reigneth there seven years and six months, and thirty and three years he hath reigned in Jerusalem.
texts.1ch.3.5: And these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon -- four, of Bath-Sheba daughter of Ammiel:
texts.1ch.3.6: also Ibhar, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
texts.1ch.3.7: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
texts.1ch.3.8: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
texts.1ch.3.9: All [are] sons of David, apart from sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
texts.1ch.3.10: And the son of Solomon [is] Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
texts.1ch.3.11: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
