texts.1ch.3.12: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
texts.1ch.3.13: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
texts.1ch.3.14: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
texts.1ch.3.15: And sons of Josiah: the first-born Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
texts.1ch.3.16: And sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
texts.1ch.3.17: And sons of Jeconiah: Assir; Salathiel his son;
texts.1ch.3.18: also Malchiram and Pedaiah, and Shenazzar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
texts.1ch.3.19: And sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel, and Shimei. And sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister,
texts.1ch.3.20: and Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab-Hesed, five.
texts.1ch.3.21: And sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah, and Jesaiah, sons of Rephaiah, sons of Arnan, sons of Obadiah, sons of Shechaniah.
texts.1ch.3.22: And sons of Shechaniah: Shemaiah; and sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
texts.1ch.3.23: And sons of Neariah: Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.
texts.1ch.3.24: And sons of Elioenai: Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
texts.1ch.4.1: Sons of Judah: Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
texts.1ch.4.2: And Reaiah son of Shobal begat Jahath, and Jahath begat Ahumai and Lahad; these [are] families of the Zorathite.
texts.1ch.4.3: And these [are] of the father of Etam: Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash; and the name of their sister [is] Hazzelelponi,
texts.1ch.4.4: and Penuel [is] father of Gedor, and Ezer father of Hushah. These [are] sons of Hur, first-born of Ephratah, father of Beth-Lehem.
texts.1ch.4.5: And to Ashhur father of Tekoa were two wives, Helah and Naarah;
texts.1ch.4.6: and Naarah beareth to him Ahuzzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari: these [are] sons of Naarah.
texts.1ch.4.7: And sons of Helah: Zereth, and Zohar, and Ethnan.
texts.1ch.4.8: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel son of Harum.
texts.1ch.4.9: And Jabez is honoured above his brethren, and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, `Because I have brought forth with grief.'
texts.1ch.4.10: And Jabez calleth to the God of Israel, saying, `If blessing Thou dost bless me, then Thou hast made great my border, and Thy hand hath been with me, and Thou hast kept [me] from evil -- not to grieve me;' and God bringeth in that which he asked.
texts.1ch.4.11: And Chelub brother of Shuah begat Mehir; he [is] father of Eshton.
texts.1ch.4.12: And Eshton begat Beth-Rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah father of Ir-Nahash; these [are] men of Rechah.
texts.1ch.4.13: And sons of Kenaz: Othniel, and Seraiah; and sons of Othniel: Hathath.
texts.1ch.4.14: And Meonothai begat Ophrah, and Seraiah begat Joab father of the valley of artificers, for they were artificers.
texts.1ch.4.15: And sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam; and sons of Elah, even Kenaz.
texts.1ch.4.16: And sons of Jehaleleel: Ziph and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.
texts.1ch.4.17: And sons of Ezra [are] Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she beareth Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah father of Eshtemoa.
texts.1ch.4.18: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered father of Gedor, and Heber father of Socho, and Jekuthiel father of Zanoah. And these [are] sons of Bithiah daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took,
texts.1ch.4.19: and sons of the wife of Hodiah sister of Nahom: Abi-Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
texts.1ch.4.20: And sons of Shimon [are] Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-Hanon, and Tilon; and sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben-Zoheth.
texts.1ch.4.21: Sons of Shelah son of Judah: Er father of Lecah, and Laadah father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of the service of fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;
texts.1ch.4.22: and Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who ruled over Moab and Jashubi-Lehem; and these things [are] ancient.
texts.1ch.4.23: They [are] the potters and inhabitants of Netaim and Gedera; with the king in his work they dwelt there.
texts.1ch.4.24: Sons of Simeon: Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
texts.1ch.4.25: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
texts.1ch.4.26: And sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.
texts.1ch.4.27: And to Shimei [are] sixteen sons and six daughters, and to his brethren there are not many sons, and none of their families have multiplied as much as the sons of Judah.
texts.1ch.4.28: And they dwell in Beer-Sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-Shaul,
texts.1ch.4.29: and in Bilhah, and in Ezem, and in Tolad,
texts.1ch.4.30: and in Bethuel, and in Hormah, and in Ziklag,
texts.1ch.4.31: and in Beth-Marcaboth, and in Hazar-Susim, and in Beth-Birei, and in Shaarim; these [are] their cities till the reigning of David.
texts.1ch.4.32: And their villages [are] Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities,
texts.1ch.4.33: and all their villages that [are] round about these cities unto Baal; these [are] their dwellings, and they have their genealogy:
texts.1ch.4.34: even Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah son of Amaziah,
texts.1ch.4.35: and Joel, and Jehu son of Josibiah, son of Seraiah, son of Asiel,
texts.1ch.4.36: and Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
texts.1ch.4.37: and Ziza son of Shiphi, son of Allon, son of Jedaiah, son of Shimri, son of Shemaiah.
texts.1ch.4.38: These who are coming in by name [are] princes in their families, and the house of their fathers have broken forth into a multitude;
texts.1ch.4.39: and they go to the entrance of Gedor, unto the east of the valley, to seek pasture for their flock,
texts.1ch.4.40: and they find pasture, fat and good, and the land broad of sides, and quiet, and safe, for of Ham are those dwelling there before.
texts.1ch.4.41: And these who are written by name come in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smite their tents, and the habitations that have been found there, and devote them to destruction unto this day, and dwell in their stead, because pasture for their flock [is] there.
texts.1ch.4.42: And of them, of the sons of Simeon, there have gone to mount Seir, five hundred men, and Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, sons of Ishi, at their head,
texts.1ch.4.43: and they smite the remnant of those escaped of Amalek, and dwell there unto this day.
texts.1ch.5.1: As to sons of Reuben, first-born of Israel -- for he [is] the first-born, and on account of his profaning the couch of his father hath his birthright been given to the sons of Joseph son of Israel, and [he is] not to be reckoned by genealogy for the birthright,
texts.1ch.5.2: for Judah hath been mighty over his brother, and for leader above him, and the birthright [is] to Joseph.
texts.1ch.5.3: Sons of Reuben, first-born of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
texts.1ch.5.4: Sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
texts.1ch.5.5: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
texts.1ch.5.6: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-Pilneser king of Asshur removed; he [is] prince of the Reubenite.
texts.1ch.5.7: And his brethren, by their families, in the genealogy of their generations, [are] heads: Jeiel, and Zechariah,
texts.1ch.5.8: and Bela son of Azaz, son of Shema, son of Joel -- he is dwelling in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baal-Meon;
texts.1ch.5.9: and at the east he dwelt even unto the entering in of the wilderness, even from the river Phrat, for their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
texts.1ch.5.10: And in the days of Saul they have made war with the Hagarites, who fall by their hand, and they dwell in their tents over all the face of the east of Gilead.
texts.1ch.5.11: And the sons of Gad, over-against them have dwelt in the land of Bashan unto Salcah,
texts.1ch.5.12: Joel the head, and Shapham the second, and Jaanai and Shaphat in Bashan;
texts.1ch.5.13: and their brethren of the house of their fathers [are] Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.
texts.1ch.5.14: These [are] sons of Abihail son of Huri, son of Jaroah, son of Gilead, son of Michael, son of Jeshishai, son of Jahdo, son of Buz;
texts.1ch.5.15: Ahi son of Abdiel, son of Guni, [is] head of the house of their fathers;
texts.1ch.5.16: and they dwell in Gilead in Bashan, and in her small towns, and in all suburbs of Sharon, upon their outskirts;
texts.1ch.5.17: all of them reckoned themselves by genealogy in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
texts.1ch.5.18: Sons of Reuben, and the Gadite, and the half of the tribe of Manasseh, of sons of valour, men bearing shield and sword, and treading bow, and taught in battle, [are] forty and four thousand and seven hundred and sixty, going out to the host.
texts.1ch.5.19: And they make war with the Hagarites, and Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab,
texts.1ch.5.20: and they are helped against them, and the Hagarites are given into their hand, and all who [are] with them, for they cried to God in battle, and He was entreated of them, because they trusted in Him.
texts.1ch.5.21: And they take captive their cattle, of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of human beings a hundred thousand;
texts.1ch.5.22: for many have fallen pierced, for of God [is] the battle; and they dwell in their stead till the removal.
texts.1ch.5.23: And the sons of the half of the tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land, from Bashan unto Baal-Hermon, and Senir, and mount Hermon, they have multiplied.
texts.1ch.5.24: And these [are] heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, men mighty in valour, men of name, heads to the house of their fathers.
texts.1ch.5.25: And they trespass against the God of their fathers, and go a-whoring after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed from their presence;
texts.1ch.5.26: and stir up doth the God of Israel the spirit of Pul king of Asshur, and the spirit of Tilgath-Pilneser king of Asshur, and he removeth them -- even the Reubenite, and the Gadite, and the half of the tribe of Manasseh -- and bringeth them in to Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and the river of Gozan unto this day.
texts.1ch.6.1: Sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
texts.1ch.6.2: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
texts.1ch.6.3: And sons of Amram: Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. And sons of Aaron: Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
texts.1ch.6.4: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,
texts.1ch.6.5: and Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,
texts.1ch.6.6: and Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,
texts.1ch.6.7: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
texts.1ch.6.8: and Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,
texts.1ch.6.9: and Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,
texts.1ch.6.10: and Johanan begat Azariah, him who acted as priest in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.
texts.1ch.6.11: And Azariah begetteth Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
texts.1ch.6.12: and Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,
texts.1ch.6.13: and Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,
texts.1ch.6.14: and Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak;
texts.1ch.6.15: and Jehozadak hath gone in Jehovah's removing Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
texts.1ch.6.16: Sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
texts.1ch.6.17: And these [are] names of sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
texts.1ch.6.18: And sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
texts.1ch.6.19: Sons of Merari; Mahli and Mushi. And these [are] families of the Levite according to their fathers;
texts.1ch.6.20: of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
texts.1ch.6.21: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.
texts.1ch.6.22: Sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
texts.1ch.6.23: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
texts.1ch.6.24: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
texts.1ch.6.25: And sons of Elkanah; Amasai and Ahimoth.
texts.1ch.6.26: Elkanah; sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
texts.1ch.6.27: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
texts.1ch.6.28: And sons of Samuel: the first-born Vashni, and the second Abijah.
texts.1ch.6.29: Sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
texts.1ch.6.30: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
texts.1ch.6.31: And these [are] they whom David stationed over the parts of the song of the house of Jehovah, from the resting of the ark,
texts.1ch.6.32: and they are ministering before the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, in song, till the building by Solomon of the house of Jehovah in Jerusalem; and they stand according to their ordinance over their service.
texts.1ch.6.33: And these [are] those standing, and their sons: of the sons of the Kohathite: Heman the singer, son of Joel, son of Shemuel,
texts.1ch.6.34: son of Elkanah, son of Jeroham, son of Eliel, son of Toah,
texts.1ch.6.35: son of Zuph, son of Elkanah, son of Mahath, son of Amasai,
texts.1ch.6.36: son of Elkanah, son of Joel, son of Azariah, son of Zephaniah,
texts.1ch.6.37: son of Tahath, son of Assir, son of Ebiasaph, son of Korah,
texts.1ch.6.38: son of Izhar, son of Kohath, son of Levi, son of Israel.
texts.1ch.6.39: And his brother Asaph, who is standing on his right -- Asaph, son of Berachiah, son of Shimea,
texts.1ch.6.40: son of Michael, son of Baaseiah, son of Malchiah,
texts.1ch.6.41: son of Ethni, son of Zerah, son of Adaiah,
texts.1ch.6.42: son of Ethan, son of Zimmah, son of Shimei,
texts.1ch.6.43: son of Jahath, son of Gershom, son of Levi.
texts.1ch.6.44: And sons of Merari, their brethren, [are] on the left. Ethan son of Kishi, son of Abdi, son of Malluch,
texts.1ch.6.45: son of Hashabiah, son of Amaziah, son of Hilkiah,
texts.1ch.6.46: son of Amzi, son of Bani, son of Shamer,
texts.1ch.6.47: son of Mahli, son of Mushi, son of Merari, son of Levi.
texts.1ch.6.48: And their brethren the Levites are put to all the service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
texts.1ch.6.49: And Aaron and his sons are making perfume on the altar of the burnt-offering, and on the altar of the perfume, for all the work of the holy of holies, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses servant of God commanded.
texts.1ch.6.50: And these [are] sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
texts.1ch.6.51: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
texts.1ch.6.52: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
texts.1ch.6.53: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
texts.1ch.6.54: And these [are] their dwellings, throughout their towers, in their borders, of the sons of Aaron, of the family of the Kohathite, for theirs was the lot;
texts.1ch.6.55: and they give to them Hebron in the land of Judah and its suburbs round about it;
texts.1ch.6.56: and the field of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
texts.1ch.6.57: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge: Hebron, and Libnah and its suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa and its suburbs,
texts.1ch.6.58: and Hilen and its suburbs, Debir and its suburbs,
texts.1ch.6.59: and Ashan and its suburbs, and Beth-Shemesh and its suburbs.
texts.1ch.6.60: And from the tribe of Benjamin, Geba and its suburbs, and Allemeth and its suburbs, and Anathoth and its suburbs. All their cities [are] thirteen cities, for their families.
texts.1ch.6.61: And to the sons of Kohath, those left of the family of the tribe, from the half of the tribe, the half of Manasseh, by lot, [are] ten cities.
texts.1ch.6.62: And to the sons of Gershom, for their families, from the tribe of Issachar, and from the tribe of Asher, and from the tribe of Naphtali, and from the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
texts.1ch.6.63: To the sons of Merari, for their families, from the tribe of Reuben, and from the tribe of Gad, and from the tribe of Zebulun, by lot, twelve cities.
texts.1ch.6.64: And the sons of Israel give to the Levites the cities and their suburbs.
texts.1ch.6.65: And they give by lot from the tribe of the sons of Judah, and from the tribe of the sons of Simeon, and from the tribe of the sons of Benjamin, these cities which they call by name;
texts.1ch.6.66: and some of the families of the sons of Kohath have cities of their border from the tribe of Ephraim;
texts.1ch.6.67: and they give to them the cities of refuge, Shechem and its suburbs in the hill-country of Ephraim, and Gezer and its suburbs,
texts.1ch.6.68: and Jokmeam and its suburbs, and Beth-Horan and its suburbs,
texts.1ch.6.69: and Aijalon and its suburbs, and Gath-Rimmon and its suburbs;
texts.1ch.6.70: and from the half tribe of Manasseh, Aner and its suburbs, and Bileam and its suburbs, for the family of the sons of Kohath who are left.
texts.1ch.6.71: To the sons of Gershom from the family of the half of the tribe of Manasseh [are] Golan in Bashan and its suburbs, and Ashtaroth and its suburbs;
texts.1ch.6.72: and from the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh and its suburbs, Daberath and its suburbs,
texts.1ch.6.73: and Ramoth and its suburbs, and Anem and its suburbs;
texts.1ch.6.74: and from the tribe of Asher; Mashal and its suburbs, and Abdon and its suburbs,
texts.1ch.6.75: and Hukok and its suburbs, and Rehob and its suburbs;
texts.1ch.6.76: and from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee and its suburbs, and Hammon and its suburbs, and Kirjathaim and its suburbs.
texts.1ch.6.77: To the sons of Merari who are left, from the tribe of Zebulun, [are] Rimmon and its suburbs, Tabor and its suburbs;
texts.1ch.6.78: and from beyond the Jordan by Jericho, at the east of the Jordan, from the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness and its suburbs, and Jahzah and its suburbs,
texts.1ch.6.79: and Kedemoth and its suburbs, and Mephaath and its suburbs;
texts.1ch.6.80: and from the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead and its suburbs, and Mahanaim and its suburbs,
texts.1ch.6.81: and Heshbon and its suburbs, and Jazer and its suburbs.
texts.1ch.7.1: And sons of Issachar; Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
texts.1ch.7.2: And sons of Tola: Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of the house of their fathers, [even] of Tola, mighty of valour in their generations: their number in the days of David [is] twenty and two thousand and six hundred.
texts.1ch.7.3: And sons of Uzzi: Izrahiah; and sons of Izrahiah: Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, Hamishah -- all of them heads.
texts.1ch.7.4: And beside them, by their generations, of the house of their fathers, [are] troops of the host of battle, thirty and six thousand, for they multiplied wives and sons;
texts.1ch.7.5: and their brethren of all the families of Issachar [are] mighty of valour, eighty and seven thousand, all have their genealogy.
texts.1ch.7.6: Of Benjamin: Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.
texts.1ch.7.7: And sons of Bela: Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of a house of fathers, mighty of valour, with their genealogy, twenty and two thousand, and thirty and four.
texts.1ch.7.8: And sons of Becher: Zemirah, and Joash, and Eliezar, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abijah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these [are] sons of Becher,
texts.1ch.7.9: with their genealogy, after their generations, heads of a house of their fathers, mighty of valour, twenty thousand and two hundred.
texts.1ch.7.10: And sons of Jediael: Bilhan; and sons of Bilhan: Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
texts.1ch.7.11: All these [are] sons of Jediael, even heads of the fathers, mighty in valour, seventeen thousand and two hundred going out to the host for battle.
texts.1ch.7.12: And Shuppim and Huppim [are] sons of Ir; Hushim son of Aher.
texts.1ch.7.13: Sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, sons of Bilhah.
texts.1ch.7.14: Sons of Manasseh: Ashriel, whom Jaladah his Aramaean concubine bare, with Machir father of Gilead.
texts.1ch.7.15: And Machir took wives for Huppim and for Shuppim, and the name of the one [is] Maachah, and the name of the second Zelophehad, and Zelophehad hath daughters.
texts.1ch.7.16: And Maachah wife of Machir beareth a son and calleth his name Peresh, and the name of his brother [is] Sheresh, and his sons [are] Ulam and Rakem.
texts.1ch.7.17: And son of Ulam: Bedan. These [are] sons of Gilead son of Machir, son of Manasseh.
texts.1ch.7.18: And his sister Hammolecheth bare Ishhod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.
texts.1ch.7.19: And the sons of Shemida are Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
texts.1ch.7.20: And sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,
texts.1ch.7.21: and Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead; and slain them have men of Gath who are born in the land, because they came down to take their cattle.
texts.1ch.7.22: And Ephraim their father mourneth many days, and his brethren come in to comfort him,
texts.1ch.7.23: and he goeth in unto his wife, and she conceiveth and beareth a son, and he calleth his name Beriah, because in evil had been his house, --
texts.1ch.7.24: and his daughter [is] Sherah, and she buildeth Beth-Horon, the lower and the upper, and Uzzen-Sherah --
texts.1ch.7.25: and Rephah [is] his son, and Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
texts.1ch.7.26: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
texts.1ch.7.27: Non his son, Jehoshua his son.
texts.1ch.7.28: And their possession and their dwellings [are] Beth-El and its small towns, and to the east Naaran, and to the west Gezer and its small towns, and Shechem and its small towns, unto Gaza and its small towns;
texts.1ch.7.29: and by the parts of the sons of Manasseh, Beth-Shean and its small towns, Taanach and its small towns, Megiddo and its small towns, Dor and its small towns; in these dwelt the sons of Joseph son of Israel.
texts.1ch.7.30: Son of Asher: Imnah, and Ishve, and Ishvi, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
texts.1ch.7.31: And sons of Beriah: Heber, and Malchiel -- he [is] father of Birzavith.
texts.1ch.7.32: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
texts.1ch.7.33: And sons of Japhlet: Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath; these [are] sons of Japhlet.
texts.1ch.7.34: and sons of Shamer: Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
texts.1ch.7.35: And son of Helem his brother: Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
texts.1ch.7.36: Sons of Zophah: Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
texts.1ch.7.37: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
texts.1ch.7.38: And sons of Jether: Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.
texts.1ch.7.39: And sons of Ulla: Arah, and Hanniel, and Rezia.
texts.1ch.7.40: All these [are] sons of Asher, heads of the house of the fathers, chosen ones, mighty in valour, heads of the princes, with their genealogy, for the host, for battle, their number [is] twenty and six thousand men.
texts.1ch.8.1: And Benjamin begat Bela his first-born, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
texts.1ch.8.2: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
texts.1ch.8.3: And there are sons to Bela: Addar, and Gera,
texts.1ch.8.4: and Abihud, and Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,
texts.1ch.8.5: and Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.
texts.1ch.8.6: And these [are] sons of Ehud: they are heads of fathers to the inhabitants of Geba, and they remove them unto Manahath;
texts.1ch.8.7: and Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza and Ahihud.
texts.1ch.8.8: And Shaharaim begat in the field of Moab, after his sending them away; Hushim and Baara [are] his wives.
texts.1ch.8.9: And he begetteth of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,
texts.1ch.8.10: and Jeuz, and Shachiah, and Mirmah. These [are] his sons, heads of fathers.
texts.1ch.8.11: And of Hushim he begat Ahitub and Elpaal.
texts.1ch.8.12: And sons of Elpaal: Eber, and Misheam, and Shamer, (he built Ono and Lod and its small towns),
texts.1ch.8.13: and Beriah and Shema, (they [are] the heads of fathers to the inhabitants of Aijalon -- they caused to flee the inhabitants of Gath),
texts.1ch.8.15: and Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,
texts.1ch.8.16: and Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, sons of Beriah,
texts.1ch.8.17: and Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,
texts.1ch.8.18: and Ishmerai, and Jezliah, and Jobab, sons of Elpaal;
texts.1ch.8.19: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
texts.1ch.8.20: and Elienai, and Zillethai, and Eliel,
texts.1ch.8.21: and Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, sons of Shimei;
texts.1ch.8.22: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,
texts.1ch.8.23: and Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
texts.1ch.8.24: and Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,
texts.1ch.8.25: and Iphedeiah, and Penuel, sons of Shashak;
texts.1ch.8.26: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,
texts.1ch.8.27: and Jaareshiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, sons of Jeroham.
texts.1ch.8.28: These [are] heads of fathers, by their generations, heads; these dwelt in Jerusalem.
texts.1ch.8.29: And in Gibeon hath the father of Gibeon dwelt, and the name of his wife [is] Maachah;
texts.1ch.8.30: and his son, the first-born, [is] Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
texts.1ch.8.31: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher;
texts.1ch.8.32: and Mikloth begat Shimeah. And they also over-against their brethren dwelt in Jerusalem with their brethren.
texts.1ch.8.33: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-Shua, and Abinadab, and Esh-Baal.
texts.1ch.8.34: And a son of Jonathan [is] Merib-Baal, and Merib-Baal begat Micah;
texts.1ch.8.35: and sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz:
texts.1ch.8.36: and Ahaz begat Jehoadah, and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,
texts.1ch.8.37: and Moza begat Binea, Raphah [is] his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
texts.1ch.8.38: And to Azel [are] six sons, and these [are] their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these [are] sons of Azel.
texts.1ch.8.39: And sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his first-born, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
texts.1ch.8.40: And the sons of Ulam are men mighty in valour, treading bow, and multiplying sons and son's sons, a hundred and fifty. All these [are] of the sons of Benjamin.
texts.1ch.9.1: And all Israel have reckoned themselves by genealogy, and lo, they are written on the book of the kings of Israel and Judah -- they were removed to Babylon for their trespass.
texts.1ch.9.2: And the first inhabitants, who [are] in their possession, in their cities, of Israel, [are] the priests, the Levites, and the Nethinim.
texts.1ch.9.3: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the sons of Judah, and of the sons of Benjamin, and of the sons of Ephraim and Manasseh:
texts.1ch.9.4: Uthai son of Ammihud, son of Omri, son of Imri, son of Bani, of the sons of Pharez, son of Judah.
texts.1ch.9.5: And of the Shilonite: Asaiah the first-born, and his sons.
texts.1ch.9.6: And of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
texts.1ch.9.7: And of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, son of Hodaviah, son of Hassenuah,
texts.1ch.9.8: and Ibneiah son of Jeroham, and Elah son of Uzzi, son of Michri, and Meshullam son of Shephatiah, son of Reuel, son of Ibnijah.
texts.1ch.9.9: And their brethren, according to their generations, [are] nine hundred and fifty and six. All these [are] men, heads of fathers, according to the house of their fathers.
texts.1ch.9.10: And of the priests: Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,
texts.1ch.9.11: and Azariah son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub, leader in the house of God;
texts.1ch.9.12: and Adaiah son of Jeroham, son of Pashhur, son of Malchijah, and Maasai son of Adiel, son of Jahzerah, son of Meshullam, son of Meshillemith, son of Immer.
texts.1ch.9.13: And their brethren, heads to the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and sixty, mighty in valour, [are] for the work of the service of the house of God.
texts.1ch.9.14: And of the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hashshub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
texts.1ch.9.15: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah son of Micah, son of Zichri, son of Asaph;
texts.1ch.9.16: and Obadiah son of Shemariah, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah, son of Asa, son of Elkanah, who is dwelling in the villages of the Netophathite.
texts.1ch.9.17: And the gatekeepers [are] Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren -- Shallum [is] the head;
texts.1ch.9.18: and hitherto they [are] at the gate of the king eastward; they [are] the gatekeepers for the companies of the sons of Levi.
texts.1ch.9.19: And Shallum son of Kore, son of Ebiasaph, son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, [are] over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent, and their fathers [are] over the camp of Jehovah, keepers of the entrance;
texts.1ch.9.20: and Phinehas son of Eleazar hath been leader over them formerly; Jehovah [is] with him.
texts.1ch.9.21: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah [is] gatekeeper at the opening of the tent of meeting.
texts.1ch.9.22: All of those who are chosen for gatekeepers at the thresholds [are] two hundred and twelve; they [are] in their villages, by their genealogy; they whom David and Samuel the seer appointed in their office.
texts.1ch.9.23: And they and their sons [are] over the gates of the house of Jehovah, even of the house of the tent, by watches.
texts.1ch.9.24: At four sides are the gatekeepers, east, west, north, and south.
texts.1ch.9.25: And their brethren in their villages [are] to come in for seven days from time to time with these.
texts.1ch.9.26: For in office [are] the four chiefs of the gatekeepers, they are Levites, and they have been over the chambers, and over the treasuries of the house of God,
texts.1ch.9.27: and round about the house of God they lodge, for on them [is] the watch, and they [are] over the opening, even morning by morning.
texts.1ch.9.28: And [some] of them [are] over the vessels of service, for by number they bring them in, and by number they take them out.
texts.1ch.9.29: And [some] of them are appointed over the vessels, even over all the vessels of the sanctuary, and over the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
texts.1ch.9.30: And [some] of the sons of the priests are mixing the mixture for spices.
texts.1ch.9.31: And Mattithiah, of the Levites (he [is] the first-born to Shallum the Korahite), [is] in office over the work of the pans.
texts.1ch.9.32: And of the sons of the Kohathite, [some] of their brethren [are] over the bread of the arrangement, to prepare [it] sabbath by sabbath.
texts.1ch.9.33: And these who sing, heads of fathers of the Levites, in the chambers, [are] free, for by day and by night [they are] over them in the work.
texts.1ch.9.34: These heads of the fathers of the Levites throughout their generations [are] heads. These have dwelt in Jerusalem.
texts.1ch.9.35: And in Gibeon dwelt hath the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, and the name of his wife [is] Maachah;
texts.1ch.9.36: and his son, the first-born, [is] Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
texts.1ch.9.37: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
texts.1ch.9.38: And Mikloth begat Shimeam, and they also, over-against their brethren, have dwelt in Jerusalem with their brethren.
texts.1ch.9.39: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-Shua, and Abinadab, and Esh-Baal.
texts.1ch.9.40: And a son of Jonathan [is] Merib-Baal, and Merib-Baal begat Micah.
texts.1ch.9.41: And sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea,
texts.1ch.9.42: and Ahaz -- he begat Jaarah, and Jaarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri, and Zimri begat Moza,
texts.1ch.9.43: and Moza begat Binea, and Rephaiah [is] his son. Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
texts.1ch.9.44: And to Azel [are] six sons, and these their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these [are] sons of Azel.
texts.1ch.10.1: And the Philistines have fought with Israel, and the men of Israel flee from the face of the Philistines, and fall wounded in mount Gilboa,
texts.1ch.10.2: and the Philistines pursue after Saul, and after his sons, and the Philistines smite Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-Shua, sons of Saul.
texts.1ch.10.3: And the battle [is] heavy on Saul, and those shooting with the bow find him, and he is wounded by those shooting,
texts.1ch.10.4: and Saul saith unto the bearer of his weapons, `Draw thy sword, and pierce me with it, lest these uncircumcised come -- and have abused me.' And the bearer of his weapons hath not been willing, for he feareth exceedingly, and Saul taketh the sword, and falleth upon it;
texts.1ch.10.5: and the bearer of his weapons seeth that Saul [is] dead, and falleth, he also, on the sword, and dieth;
texts.1ch.10.6: and Saul dieth, and his three sons, and all his house -- together they died.
texts.1ch.10.7: And all the men of Israel who [are] in the valley see that they have fled, and that Saul and his sons have died, and they forsake their cities and flee, and the Philistines come and dwell in them.
texts.1ch.10.8: And it cometh to pass, on the morrow, that the Philistines come to strip the wounded, and find Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa,
texts.1ch.10.9: and strip him, and bear away his head, and his weapons, and send into the land of the Philistines round about to proclaim tidings [to] their idols and the people,
texts.1ch.10.10: and put his weapons in the house of their gods, and his skull they have fixed in the house of Dagon.
texts.1ch.10.11: And all Jabesh-Gilead hear of all that the Philistines have done to Saul,
texts.1ch.10.12: and all the men of valour rise and bear away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and bring them in to Jabesh, and bury their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fast seven days.
texts.1ch.10.13: And Saul dieth because of his trespass that he trespassed against Jehovah, against the word of Jehovah that he kept not, and also for asking at a familiar spirit -- to inquire, --
texts.1ch.10.14: and he inquired not at Jehovah, and He putteth him to death, and turneth round the kingdom to David son of Jesse.
texts.1ch.11.1: And gathered are all Israel unto David to Hebron, saying, `Lo, thy bone and thy flesh [are] we;
texts.1ch.11.2: even in time past, even in Saul's being king, it is thou who art taking out and bringing in Israel, and Jehovah thy God saith to thee: Thou dost feed My people Israel, and thou art leader over My people Israel.'
texts.1ch.11.3: And all the elders of Israel come in unto the king to Hebron, and David maketh with them a covenant in Hebron before Jehovah, and they anoint David for king over Israel, according to the word of Jehovah by the hand of Samuel.
texts.1ch.11.4: And David goeth, and all Israel, to Jerusalem -- it [is] Jebus -- and there the Jebusite, the inhabitants of the land.
texts.1ch.11.5: And the inhabitants of Jebus say to David, `Thou dost not come in hither;' and David captureth the fortress of Zion -- it [is] the city of David.
texts.1ch.11.6: And David saith, `Whoever smiteth the Jebusite first doth become head and prince;' and go up first doth Joab son of Zeruiah and becometh head.
texts.1ch.11.7: And David dwelleth in the fortress, therefore they have called it, `City of David;'
texts.1ch.11.8: and he buildeth the city round about, from Millo, and unto the circumference, and Joab restoreth the rest of the city.
texts.1ch.11.9: And David goeth, going on and becoming great, and Jehovah of Hosts [is] with him.
texts.1ch.11.10: And these [are] heads of the mighty ones whom David hath, who are strengthening themselves with him in his kingdom, with all Israel, to cause him to reign, according to the word of Jehovah, over Israel.
texts.1ch.11.11: And this [is] an account of the mighty ones whom David hath: Jashobeam son of a Hachmonite [is] head of the thirty; he is lifting up his spear against three hundred -- wounded, at one time.
texts.1ch.11.12: And after him [is] Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite, he [is] among the three mighty;
texts.1ch.11.13: he hath been with David in Pas-Dammim, and the Philistines have been gathered there to battle, and a portion of the field is full of barley, and the people have fled from the face of the Philistines,
texts.1ch.11.14: and they station themselves in the midst of the portion, and deliver it, and smite the Philistines, and Jehovah saveth -- a great salvation.
texts.1ch.11.15: And three of the thirty heads go down on the rock unto David, unto the cave of Adullam, and the host of the Philistines is encamping in the valley of Rephaim,
texts.1ch.11.16: and David [is] then in the fortress, and the station of the Philistines [is] then in Beth-Lehem,
texts.1ch.11.17: and David longeth, and saith, `Who doth give me to drink water from the well of Beth-Lehem, that [is] at the gate!'
texts.1ch.11.18: And the three break through the camp of the Philistines, and draw water from the well of Beth-Lehem, that [is] at the gate, and bear and bring in unto David, and David hath not been willing to drink it, and poureth it out to Jehovah,
texts.1ch.11.19: and saith, `Far be it from me, by my God, to do this; the blood of these men do I drink with their lives? for with their lives they have brought it;' and he was not willing to drink it; these [things] did the three mighty ones.
texts.1ch.11.20: And Abishai brother of Joab, he hath been head of the three: and he is lifting up his spear against three hundred -- wounded, and hath a name among three.
texts.1ch.11.21: Of the three by the two he is honoured, and becometh their head; and unto the [first] three he hath not come.
texts.1ch.11.22: Benaiah son of Jehoiada, son of a man of valour, of great deeds, from Kabzeel: he hath smitten the two lion-like Moabites, and he hath gone down and smitten the lion in the midst of the pit, in the day of snow.
texts.1ch.11.23: And he hath smitten the man, the Egyptian -- a man of measure, five by the cubit -- and in the hand of the Egyptian [is] a spear like a beam of weavers, and he goeth down unto him with a rod, and taketh violently away the spear out of the hand of the Egyptian, and slayeth him with his own spear.
texts.1ch.11.24: These [things] hath Benaiah son of Jehoiada done, and hath a name among the three mighty ones.
texts.1ch.11.25: Of the thirty, lo, he [is] honoured, and unto the [first] three he hath not come, and David setteth him over his guard.
texts.1ch.11.26: And the mighty ones of the forces [are] Asahel brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo of Beth-Lehem,
texts.1ch.11.27: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
texts.1ch.11.28: Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abi-Ezer the Annethothite,
texts.1ch.11.29: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
texts.1ch.11.30: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite,
texts.1ch.11.31: Ithai son of Ribai of Gibeah, of the sons of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
texts.1ch.11.32: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
texts.1ch.11.33: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
texts.1ch.11.34: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan son of Shage the Hararite,
texts.1ch.11.35: Ahiam son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal son of Ur,
texts.1ch.11.36: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
texts.1ch.11.37: Hezor the Carmelite, Naarai son of Ezbai,
texts.1ch.11.38: Joel brother of Nathan, Mibhar son of Haggeri,
texts.1ch.11.39: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, bearer of the weapons of Joab son of Zeruiah,
texts.1ch.11.40: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
texts.1ch.11.41: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad son of Ahlai,
texts.1ch.11.42: Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, head of the Reubenites, and by him thirty,
texts.1ch.11.43: Hanan son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
texts.1ch.11.44: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel sons of Hothan the Aroerite,
texts.1ch.11.45: Jediael son of Shimri, and Joha his brother the Tizite,
texts.1ch.11.46: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
texts.1ch.11.47: Eliel, and Obed, and Jaasiel the Mesobaite.
texts.1ch.12.1: And these [are] those coming in unto David to Ziklag, while shut up because of Saul son of Kish, and they [are] among the mighty ones, helping the battle,
texts.1ch.12.2: armed with bow, right and left handed, with stones, and with arrows, with bows, of the brethren of Saul, of Benjamin.
texts.1ch.12.3: The head [is] Ahiezer, and Joash, sons of Shemaab the Gibeathite, and Jeziel, and Pelet, sons of Azmaveth, and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,
texts.1ch.12.4: and Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty one among the thirty, and over the thirty, and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite.
texts.1ch.12.5: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite;
texts.1ch.12.6: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam the Korhites,
texts.1ch.12.7: and Joelah, and Zebadiah, sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
texts.1ch.12.8: And of the Gadite there have been separated unto David, to the fortress, to the wilderness, mighty of valour, men of the host for battle, setting in array target and buckler, and their faces the face of the lion, and as roes on the mountains for speed:
texts.1ch.12.9: Ezer the head, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
texts.1ch.12.10: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
texts.1ch.12.11: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
texts.1ch.12.12: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
texts.1ch.12.13: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbannai the eleventh.
texts.1ch.12.14: These [are] of the sons of Gad, heads of the host, one of a hundred [is] the least, and the greatest, of a thousand;
texts.1ch.12.15: these [are] they who have passed over the Jordan in the first month, -- and it is full over all its banks -- and cause all [they of] the valley to flee to the east and to the west.
texts.1ch.12.16: And there come of the sons of Benjamin and Judah unto the stronghold to David,
texts.1ch.12.17: and David goeth out before them, and answereth and saith to them, `If for peace ye have come in unto me, to help me, I have a heart to unite with you; and if to betray me to mine adversaries -- without violence in my hands -- the God of our fathers doth see and reprove.'
texts.1ch.12.18: And the Spirit hath clothed Amasai, head of the captains: `To thee, O David, and with thee, O son of Jesse -- peace! peace to thee, and peace to thy helper, for thy God hath helped thee;' and David receiveth them, and putteth them among the heads of the troop.
texts.1ch.12.19: And of Manasseh there have fallen unto David in his coming with the Philistines against Israel to battle -- and they helped them not, for by counsel the princes of the Philistines sent him away, saying, `With our heads he doth fall unto his master Saul.' --
texts.1ch.12.20: In his going unto Ziglag there have fallen unto him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zillthai, heads of the thousands that [are] of Manasseh;
texts.1ch.12.21: and they have helped with David over the troop, for mighty of valour [are] all of them, and they are captains in the host,
texts.1ch.12.22: for at that time, day by day, they come in unto David to help him, till it is a great camp, like a camp of God.
texts.1ch.12.23: And these [are] the numbers of the head, of the armed men of the host; they have come in unto David to Hebron to turn round the kingdom of Saul unto him, according to the mouth of Jehovah.
texts.1ch.12.24: The sons of Judah, bearing target and spear, [are] six thousand and eight hundred, armed ones of the host.
texts.1ch.12.25: Of the sons of Simeon, mighty ones of valour for the host, [are] seven thousand and a hundred.
texts.1ch.12.26: Of the sons of Levi [are] four thousand and six hundred;
texts.1ch.12.27: and Jehoiada [is] the leader of the Aaronite, and with him [are] three thousand and seven hundred,
texts.1ch.12.28: and Zadok, a young man, mighty of valour, and of the house of his father [are] twenty and two heads.
texts.1ch.12.29: And of the sons of Benjamin, brethren of Saul, [are] three thousand, and hitherto their greater part are keeping the charge of the house of Saul.
texts.1ch.12.30: And of the sons of Ephraim [are] twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty of valour, men of name, according to the house of their fathers.
texts.1ch.12.31: And of the half of the tribe of Manasseh [are] eighteen thousand, who have been defined by name, to come in to cause David to reign.
texts.1ch.12.32: And of the sons of Issachar, having understanding for the times, to know what Israel should do; their heads [are] two hundred, and all their brethren [are] at their command.
texts.1ch.12.33: Of Zebulun, going forth to the host, arranging battle with all instruments of battle, [are] fifty thousand, and keeping rank without a double heart.
texts.1ch.12.34: And of Naphtali, a thousand heads, and with them, with target and spear, [are] thirty and seven thousand.
texts.1ch.12.35: And of the Danite, arranging battle, [are] twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.
texts.1ch.12.36: And of Asher, going forth to the host, to arrange battle, [are] forty thousand.
texts.1ch.12.37: And from beyond the Jordan, of the Reubenite, and of the Gadite, and of the half of the tribe of Manasseh, with all instruments of the host for battle, [are] a hundred and twenty thousand.
texts.1ch.12.38: All these [are] men of war, keeping rank -- with a perfect heart they have come to Hebron, to cause David to reign over all Israel, and also all the rest of Israel [are] of one heart, to cause David to reign,
texts.1ch.12.39: and they are there, with David, three days, eating and drinking, for their brethren have prepared for them.
texts.1ch.12.40: And also those near unto them, unto Issachar, and Zebulun, and Naphtali, are bringing in bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen -- food of fine flour, fig-cakes and grape-cakes, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep, in abundance, for joy [is] in Israel.
texts.1ch.13.1: And David consulteth with the heads of the thousands, and of the hundreds, every leader,
texts.1ch.13.2: and David saith to all the assembly of Israel, `If unto you it be good, and from Jehovah our God it hath broken forth -- we send unto our brethren, those left in all the lands of Israel, and with them the priests and the Levites, in the cities of their suburbs, and they are gathered unto us,
texts.1ch.13.3: and we bring round the ark of our God unto us, for we sought Him not in the days of Saul.'
texts.1ch.13.4: And all the assembly say to do so, for the thing is right in the eyes of all the people.
texts.1ch.13.5: And David assembleth all Israel from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering in of Hamath, to bring in the ark of God from Kirjath-Jearim,
texts.1ch.13.6: and David goeth up, and all Israel, to Baalah, unto Kirjath-Jearim that [is] to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God Jehovah, inhabiting the cherubs, where the Name is called on.
texts.1ch.13.7: And they place the ark of God on a new cart, from the house of Abinadab, and Uzza and Ahio are leading the cart,
texts.1ch.13.8: and David and all Israel are playing before God, with all strength, and with songs, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
texts.1ch.13.9: And they come in unto the threshing-floor of Chidon, and Uzza putteth forth his hand to seize the ark, for the oxen were released,
texts.1ch.13.10: and the anger of Jehovah is kindled against Uzza, and He smiteth him, because that he hath put forth his hand on the ark, and he dieth there before God.
texts.1ch.13.11: And it is displeasing to David, because Jehovah hath made a breach upon Uzza, and one calleth that place `Breach of Uzza' unto this day.
texts.1ch.13.12: And David feareth God on that day, saying, `How do I bring in unto me the ark of God?'
texts.1ch.13.13: And David hath not turned aside the ark unto himself, unto the city of David, and turneth it aside unto the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.
texts.1ch.13.14: And the ark of God dwelleth with the household of Obed-Edom, in his house, three months, and Jehovah blesseth the house of Obed-Edom, and all that he hath.
texts.1ch.14.1: And Huram king of Tyre sendeth messengers unto David, and cedar-wood, and artificers of walls, and artificers of wood, to build to him a house.
texts.1ch.14.2: And David knoweth that Jehovah hath established him for king over Israel, because of the lifting up on high of his kingdom, for the sake of His people Israel.
texts.1ch.14.3: And David taketh again wives in Jerusalem, and David begetteth again sons and daughters;
texts.1ch.14.4: and these [are] the names of the children whom he hath in Jerusalem: Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
texts.1ch.14.5: and Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,
texts.1ch.14.6: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
texts.1ch.14.7: and Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.
texts.1ch.14.8: And the Philistines hear that David hath been anointed for king over all Israel, and all the Philistines go up to seek David, and David heareth, and goeth out before them.
texts.1ch.14.9: And the Philistines have come, and rush into the valley of Rephaim,
texts.1ch.14.10: and David asketh of God, saying, `Do I go up against the Philistines -- and hast Thou given them into my hand?' And Jehovah saith to him, `Go up, and I have given them into thy hand.'
texts.1ch.14.11: And they go up into Baal-Perazim, and David smiteth them there, and David saith, `God hath broken up mine enemies by my hand, like the breaking up of waters;' therefore they have called the name of that place Baal-Perazim.
texts.1ch.14.12: And they leave there their gods, and David speaketh, and they are burnt with fire.
texts.1ch.14.13: And the Philistines add again, and rush into the valley,
texts.1ch.14.14: and David asketh again of God, and God saith to him, `Do not go up after them, turn round from them, and thou hast come to them from over-against the mulberries;
texts.1ch.14.15: and it cometh to pass, when thou hearest the sound of the stepping at the heads of the mulberries, then thou goest out into battle, for God hath gone out before thee to smite the camp of the Philistines.'
texts.1ch.14.16: And David doth as God commanded him, and they smite the camp of the Philistines from Gibeon even unto Gazer;
texts.1ch.14.17: and the name of David goeth out into all the lands, and Jehovah hath put his fear on all the nations.
texts.1ch.15.1: And he maketh for himself houses in the city of David, and prepareth a place for the ark of God, and stretcheth out for it a tent.
texts.1ch.15.2: Then said David, `None [are] to carry the ark of God, except the Levites, for on them hath Jehovah fixed to carry the ark of God, and to serve Him -- unto the age.'
texts.1ch.15.3: And David assembleth all Israel unto Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of Jehovah unto its place that he had prepared for it.
texts.1ch.15.4: And David gathereth the sons of Aaron, and the Levites.
texts.1ch.15.5: Of sons of Kohath: Uriel the chief, and his brethren, a hundred and twenty.
texts.1ch.15.6: Of sons of Merari: Asaiah the chief, and his brethren, two hundred and twenty.
texts.1ch.15.7: Of sons of Gershom: Joel the chief, and his brethren, a hundred and thirty.
texts.1ch.15.8: Of sons of Elizaphan: Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren, two hundred.
texts.1ch.15.9: Of sons of Hebron: Eliel the chief, and his brethren, eighty.
texts.1ch.15.10: Of sons of Uzziel: Amminadab the chief, and his brethren, a hundred and twelve.
texts.1ch.15.11: And David calleth to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, and to the Levites, to Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
texts.1ch.15.12: and saith to them, `Ye [are] heads of the fathers of the Levites; sanctify yourselves, ye and your brethren, and ye have brought up the ark of Jehovah, God of Israel, unto [the place] I have prepared for it;
texts.1ch.15.13: because at the first [it was] not ye, Jehovah our God made a breach upon us, because we sought Him not according to the ordinance.'
texts.1ch.15.14: And the priests and the Levites sanctify themselves, to bring up the ark of Jehovah, God of Israel;
texts.1ch.15.15: and sons of the Levites bear the ark of God, as Moses commanded, according to the word of Jehovah, on their shoulder, with staves, above them.
texts.1ch.15.16: And David saith to the heads of the Levites to appoint their brethren the singers, with instruments of song, psalteries, and harps, and cymbals, sounding, to lift up with the voice for joy.
texts.1ch.15.17: And the Levites appoint Heman son of Joel, and of his brethren, Asaph son of Berechiah, and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan son of Kushaiah;
texts.1ch.15.18: and with them their brethren, the seconds [in rank], Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah; and Obed-Edom and Jeiel the gatekeepers;
texts.1ch.15.19: and the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, with cymbals of brass to sound,
texts.1ch.15.20: and Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jeheil, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries besides virgins,
texts.1ch.15.21: and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps, on the octave, to oversee.
texts.1ch.15.22: And Chenaniah, head of the Levites, [is] over the burden; he instructeth about the burden, for he [is] intelligent.
texts.1ch.15.23: And Berechiah and Elkanah [are] gatekeepers for the ark.
texts.1ch.15.24: And Shebaniah, and Joshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer the priests, are blowing with trumpets before the ark of God; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah [are] gatekeepers for the ark.
texts.1ch.15.25: And it is David, and the elders of Israel, and the heads of the thousands, who are going to bring up the ark of the covenant of Jehovah from the house of Obed-Edom with joy;
texts.1ch.15.26: and it cometh to pass, in God's helping the Levites bearing the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, that they sacrifice seven bullocks and seven rams.
texts.1ch.15.27: And David is wrapped in an upper robe of fine linen, and all the Levites who are bearing the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah head of the burden of the singers; and on David [is] an Ephod of linen.
texts.1ch.15.28: And all Israel are bringing up the ark of the covenant of Jehovah with shouting, and with the sound of a cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding with psalteries and harps,
texts.1ch.15.29: and it cometh to pass, the ark of the covenant of Jehovah is entering in unto the city of David, and Michal daughter of Saul is looking through the window, and seeth king David dancing and playing, and despiseth him in her heart.
texts.1ch.16.1: And they bring in the ark of God, and set it up in the midst of the tent that David hath stretched out for it, and they bring near burnt-offerings and peace-offerings before God;
texts.1ch.16.2: and David ceaseth from offering the burnt-offering and the peace-offerings, and blesseth the people in the name of Jehovah,
texts.1ch.16.3: and giveth a portion to every man of Israel, both man and woman: to each a cake of bread, and a measure of wine, and a grape-cake.
texts.1ch.16.4: And he putteth before the ark of Jehovah, of the Levites, ministers, even to make mention of, and to thank, and to give praise to Jehovah, God of Israel,
texts.1ch.16.5: Asaph the head, and his second Zechariah; Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with instruments of psalteries, and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals is sounding;
texts.1ch.16.6: and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests [are] with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.
texts.1ch.16.7: On that day then hath David given at the beginning to give thanks to Jehovah by the hand of Asaph and his brethren: --
texts.1ch.16.8: Give thanks to Jehovah, call in His name, Make known among the peoples His doings.
texts.1ch.16.9: Sing ye to Him, sing psalms to Him, Meditate on all His wonders.
texts.1ch.16.10: Boast yourselves in His holy name, Rejoice doth the heart of those seeking Jehovah.
texts.1ch.16.11: Seek ye Jehovah and His strength, Seek His face continually.
texts.1ch.16.12: Remember His wonders that He did, His signs, and the judgments of His mouth,
texts.1ch.16.13: O seed of Israel, His servant, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones!
texts.1ch.16.14: He [is] Jehovah our God, In all the earth [are] His judgments.
texts.1ch.16.15: Remember ye to the age His covenant, The word He commanded -- To a thousand generations,
texts.1ch.16.16: Which He hath made with Abraham, And His oath -- to Isaac,
texts.1ch.16.17: And He establisheth it to Jacob for a statute, To Israel -- a covenant age-during.
texts.1ch.16.18: Saying: To thee I give the land of Canaan, The portion of your inheritance,
texts.1ch.16.19: When ye are few of number, As a little thing, and sojourners in it.
texts.1ch.16.20: And they go up and down, From nation unto nation, And from a kingdom unto another people.
texts.1ch.16.21: He hath not suffered any to oppress them, And reproveth on their account kings:
texts.1ch.16.22: Come not against Mine anointed ones, And against My prophets do not evil.
texts.1ch.16.23: Sing to Jehovah, all the earth, Proclaim from day unto day His salvation.
texts.1ch.16.24: Rehearse among nations His glory, Among all the peoples His wonders.
texts.1ch.16.25: For great [is] Jehovah, and praised greatly, And fearful He [is] above all gods.
texts.1ch.16.26: For all gods of the peoples [are] nought, And Jehovah the heavens hath made.
texts.1ch.16.27: Honour and majesty [are] before Him, Strength and joy [are] in His place.
texts.1ch.16.28: Ascribe to Jehovah, ye families of peoples, Ascribe to Jehovah honour and strength.
texts.1ch.16.29: Ascribe to Jehovah the honour of His name, Lift up a present, and come before Him. Bow yourselves to Jehovah, In the beauty of holiness.
texts.1ch.16.30: Be pained before Him, all the earth:
texts.1ch.16.31: Also, established is the world, It is not moved! The heavens rejoice, and the earth is glad, And they say among nations: Jehovah hath reigned.
texts.1ch.16.32: Roar doth the sea, and its fulness, Exult doth the field, and all that [is] in it,
texts.1ch.16.33: Then sing do trees of the forest, From the presence of Jehovah, For He hath come to judge the earth!
texts.1ch.16.34: Give thanks to Jehovah, for good, For to the age, [is] His kindness,
texts.1ch.16.35: And say, Save us, O God of our salvation, And gather us, and deliver us from the nations, To give thanks to Thy holy name, To triumph in Thy praise.
texts.1ch.16.36: Blessed [is] Jehovah, God of Israel, From the age and unto the age;' And all the people say, `Amen,' and have given praise to Jehovah.
texts.1ch.16.37: And he leaveth there before the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, for Asaph and for his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, according to the matter of a day in its day,
texts.1ch.16.38: both Obed-Edom and their brethren, sixty and eight, and Obed-Edom son of Jeduthun, and Hosah for gatekeepers,
texts.1ch.16.39: and Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of Jehovah, in a high place that [is] in Gibeon,
texts.1ch.16.40: to cause to ascend burnt-offerings to Jehovah, on the altar of burnt-offering continually, morning and evening, and for all that is written in the law of Jehovah, that He charged on Israel.
texts.1ch.16.41: And with them [are] Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest of those chosen, who were defined by name, to give thanks to Jehovah, for to the age [is] His kindness,
texts.1ch.16.42: and with them -- Heman and Jeduthun -- [are] trumpets and cymbals for those sounding, and instruments of the song of God, and the sons of Jeduthun [are] at the gate.
texts.1ch.16.43: And all the people go, each to his house, and David turneth round to bless his house.
texts.1ch.17.1: And it cometh to pass as David sat in his house, that David saith unto Nathan the prophet, `Lo, I am dwelling in a house of cedars, and the ark of the covenant of Jehovah [is] under curtains;'
texts.1ch.17.2: and Nathan saith unto David, `All that [is] in thy heart do, for God [is] with thee.'
texts.1ch.17.3: And it cometh to pass on that night that a word of God is unto Nathan, saying,
texts.1ch.17.4: `Go, and thou hast said unto David My servant, Thus said Jehovah, Thou dost not build for Me the house to dwell in:
texts.1ch.17.5: for I have not dwelt in a house from the day that I brought up Israel till this day, and I am from tent unto tent: and from the tabernacle,
texts.1ch.17.6: whithersoever I have walked up and down among all Israel, a word spake I, with one of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed My people, saying, Why have ye not built for Me a house of cedars?
texts.1ch.17.7: `And now, thus dost thou say to My servant, to David, Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, I have taken thee from the habitation, from after the sheep, to be leader over My people Israel,
texts.1ch.17.8: and I am with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and I cut off all thine enemies from thy presence, and have made for thee a name like the name of the great ones who [are] in the earth.
texts.1ch.17.9: `And I have prepared a place for My people Israel, and planted it, and it hath dwelt in its place, and is not troubled any more, and the sons of perverseness add not to wear it out as at first,
texts.1ch.17.10: yea, even from the days that I appointed judges over My people Israel. `And I have humbled all thine enemies, and I declare to thee that a house doth Jehovah build for thee,
texts.1ch.17.11: and it hath come to pass, when thy days have been fulfilled to go with thy fathers, that I have raised up thy seed after thee, who is of thy sons, and I have established his kingdom,
texts.1ch.17.12: he doth build for Me a house, and I have established his throne unto the age;
texts.1ch.17.13: I am to him for a father, and he is to Me for a son, and My kindness I turn not aside from him as I turned it aside from him who was before thee,
texts.1ch.17.14: and I have established him in My house, and in My kingdom unto the age, and his throne is established unto the age.'
texts.1ch.17.15: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so spake Nathan unto David.
texts.1ch.17.16: And David the king cometh in and sitteth before Jehovah, and saith, `Who [am] I, O Jehovah God, and what my house, that Thou hast brought me hitherto?
texts.1ch.17.17: And this is small in Thine eyes, O God, and Thou speakest concerning the house of thy servant afar off, and hast seen me as a type of the man who is on high, O Jehovah God!
texts.1ch.17.18: `What doth David add more unto Thee for the honour of Thy servant; and Thou Thy servant hast known.
texts.1ch.17.19: O Jehovah, for Thy servant's sake, and according to Thine own heart Thou hast done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.
texts.1ch.17.20: O Jehovah, there is none like Thee, and there is no god save Thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
texts.1ch.17.21: `And who [is] as Thy people Israel, one nation in the earth whom God hath gone to ransom to Him for a people, to make for Thee a name great and fearful, to cast out from the presence of Thy people whom Thou hast ransomed out of Egypt -- nations?
texts.1ch.17.22: Yea, Thou dost appoint Thy people Israel to Thee for a people unto the age, and Thou, O Jehovah, hast been to them for God.
texts.1ch.17.23: `And now, O Jehovah, the word that Thou hast spoken concerning Thy servant, and concerning his house, let be stedfast unto the age, and do as Thou hast spoken;
texts.1ch.17.24: and let it be stedfast, and Thy name is great unto the age, saying, Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, is God to Israel, and the house of Thy servant David is established before Thee;
texts.1ch.17.25: for Thou, O my God, Thou hast uncovered the ear of Thy servant -- to build to him a house, therefore hath Thy servant found to pray before Thee.
texts.1ch.17.26: `And now, Jehovah, Thou [art] God Himself, and Thou speakest concerning Thy servant this goodness;
texts.1ch.17.27: and now, Thou hast been pleased to bless the house of Thy servant, to be to the age before Thee; for Thou, O Jehovah, hast blessed, and it is blessed to the age.'
texts.1ch.18.1: And it cometh to pass after this, that David smiteth the Philistines, and humbleth them, and taketh Gath and its small towns out of the hand of the Philistines;
texts.1ch.18.2: and he smiteth Moab, and the Moabites are servants to David, bringing a present.
texts.1ch.18.3: And David smiteth Hadarezer king of Zobah, at Hamath, in his going to establish his power by the river Phrat,
texts.1ch.18.4: and David captureth from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen, and David destroyeth utterly all the chariots, and leaveth of them a hundred chariots [only].
texts.1ch.18.5: And Aram of Damascus cometh in to give help to Hadarezer king of Zobah, and David smiteth in Aram twenty and two thousand men,
texts.1ch.18.6: and David putteth [garrisons] in Aram of Damascus, and the Aramaeans are to David for servants, bearing a present, and Jehovah giveth salvation to David whithersoever he hath gone.
texts.1ch.18.7: And David taketh the shields of gold that have been on the servants of Hadarezer, and bringeth them in to Jerusalem;
texts.1ch.18.8: and from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, hath David taken very much brass; with it hath Solomon made the brazen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
texts.1ch.18.9: And Tou king of Hamath heareth that David hath smitten the whole force of Hadarezer king of Zobah,
texts.1ch.18.10: and he sendeth Hadoram his son unto king David, to ask of him of peace, and to bless him (because that he hath fought against Hadarezer, and smiteth him, for a man of wars with Tou had Hadarezer been,) and all kinds of vessels, of gold, and silver, and brass;
texts.1ch.18.11: also them hath king David sanctified to Jehovah with the silver and the gold that he hath taken from all the nations, from Edom, and from Moab, and from the sons of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
texts.1ch.18.12: And Abishai son of Zeruiah hath smitten Edom in the valley of salt -- eighteen thousand,
texts.1ch.18.13: and he putteth in Edom garrisons, and all the Edomites are servants to David; and Jehovah saveth David whithersoever he hath gone.
texts.1ch.18.14: And David reigneth over all Israel, and he is doing judgment and righteousness to all his people,
texts.1ch.18.15: and Joab son of Zeruiah [is] over the host, and Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud [is] remembrancer,
texts.1ch.18.16: and Zadok son of Ahitub, and Abimelech son of Abiathar, [are] priests, and Shavsha [is] scribe,
texts.1ch.18.17: and Benaiah son of Jehoiada [is] over the Cherethite and the Pelethite, and the elder sons of David [are] at the hand of the king.
texts.1ch.19.1: And it cometh to pass after this, that Nahash king of the sons of Ammon dieth, and his son reigneth in his stead,
texts.1ch.19.2: and David saith, `I do kindness with Hanun son of Nahash, for his father did with me kindness;' and David sendeth messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And the servants of David come in unto the land of the sons of Ammon, unto Hanun, to comfort him,
texts.1ch.19.3: and the heads of the sons of Ammon say to Hanun, `Is David honouring thy father, in thine eyes, because he hath sent to thee comforters? in order to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out, the land, have not his servants come in unto thee?'
texts.1ch.19.4: And Hanun taketh the servants of David, and shaveth them, and cutteth their long robes in the midst, unto the buttocks, and sendeth them away.
texts.1ch.19.5: And [some] go, and declare to David concerning the men, and he sendeth to meet them -- for the men have been greatly ashamed -- and the king saith, `Dwell in Jericho till that your beard is grown, then ye have returned.'
texts.1ch.19.6: And the sons of Ammon see that they have made themselves abhorred by David, and Hanun and the sons of Ammon send a thousand talents of silver, to hire to them, from Aram-Naharaim, and from Aram-Maachah, and from Zobah, chariots and horsemen;
texts.1ch.19.7: and they hire to them two and thirty thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people, and they come in and encamp before Medeba, and the sons of Ammon have been gathered out of their cities, and come in to the battle.
texts.1ch.19.8: And David heareth, and sendeth Joab, and all the host of the mighty men,
texts.1ch.19.9: and the sons of Ammon come out and set battle in array at the opening of the city, and the kings who have come [are] by themselves in the field.
texts.1ch.19.10: And Joab seeth that the front of the battle hath been unto him, before and behind, and he chooseth out of all the choice in Israel, and setteth in array to meet Aram,
texts.1ch.19.11: and the remnant of the people he hath given into the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set in array to meet the sons of Ammon.
texts.1ch.19.12: And he saith, `If Aram be stronger than I, then thou hast been to me for salvation; and if the sons of Ammon be stronger than thou, then I have saved thee;
texts.1ch.19.13: be strong, and we strengthen ourselves, for our people, and for the cities of our God, and Jehovah doth that which is good in His eyes.'
texts.1ch.19.14: And Joab draweth nigh, and the people who [are] with him, before Aram to battle, and they flee from his face;
texts.1ch.19.15: and the sons of Ammon have seen that Aram hath fled, and they flee -- they also -- from the face of Abishai his brother, and go in to the city. And Joab cometh in to Jerusalem.
texts.1ch.19.16: And Aram seeth that they have been smitten before Israel, and send messengers, and bring out Aram that [is] beyond the River, and Shophach head of the host of Hadarezer [is] before them.
texts.1ch.19.17: And it is declared to David, and he gathereth all Israel, and passeth over the Jordan, and cometh in unto them, and setteth in array against them; yea, David setteth in array the battle to meet Aram, and they fight with him;
texts.1ch.19.18: and Aram fleeth from the face of Israel, and David slayeth of Aram seven thousand charioteers, and forty thousand footmen, and Shophach head of the host he hath put to death.
texts.1ch.19.19: And the servants of Hadarezer see that they have been smitten before Israel, and they make peace with David and serve him, and Aram hath not been willing to help the sons of Ammon any more.
texts.1ch.20.1: And it cometh to pass, at the time of the turn of the year -- at the time of the going out of the messengers -- that Joab leadeth out the force of the host, and destroyeth the land of the sons of Ammon, and cometh in and beseigeth Rabbah -- David is abiding in Jerusalem -- and Joab smiteth Rabbah, and breaketh it down.
texts.1ch.20.2: And David taketh the crown of their king from off his head, and findeth it [in] weight a talent of gold, and in it a precious stone, and it is on the head of David: and spoil of the city he hath brought out very much,
texts.1ch.20.3: and the people who [are] in it he hath brought out, and setteth to the saw, and to cutting instruments of iron, and to axes; and thus doth David to all cities of the sons of Ammon, and David turneth back, and all the people, to Jerusalem.
texts.1ch.20.4: And it cometh to pass, after this, that there remaineth war in Gezer with the Philistines, then hath Sibbechai the Hushathite smitten Sippai, of the children of the giant, and they are humbled.
texts.1ch.20.5: And there is again war with the Philistines, and Elhanan son of Jair smiteth Lahmi, brother of Goliath the Gittite, the wood of whose spear [is] like a beam of weavers.
texts.1ch.20.6: And there is again war in Gath, and there is a man of measure, and his fingers and his toes [are] six and six, twenty and four, and also, he hath been born to the giant.
texts.1ch.20.7: And he reproacheth Israel, and smite him doth Jonathan son of Shimea, brother of David.
texts.1ch.20.8: These were born to the giant in Gath, and they fall by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
texts.1ch.21.1: And there standeth up an adversary against Israel, and persuadeth David to number Israel,
texts.1ch.21.2: And David saith unto Joab, and unto the heads of the people, `Go, number Israel from Beer-Sheba even unto Dan, and bring unto me, and I know their number.'
texts.1ch.21.3: And Joab saith, `Jehovah doth add to His people as they are a hundred times; are they not, my lord, O king, all of them to my lord for servants? why doth my lord seek this? why is he for a cause of guilt to Israel?'
texts.1ch.21.4: And the word of the king [is] severe against Joab, and Joab goeth out, and goeth up and down in all Israel, and cometh in to Jerusalem.
texts.1ch.21.5: And Joab giveth the account of the numbering of the people unto David, and all Israel is a thousand thousand and a hundred thousand, each drawing sword, and Judah [is] four hundred and seventy thousand, each drawing sword.
texts.1ch.21.6: And Levi and Benjamin he hath not numbered in their midst, for the word of the king was abominable with Joab.
texts.1ch.21.7: And it is evil in the eyes of God concerning this thing, and He smiteth Israel,
texts.1ch.21.8: and David saith unto God, `I have sinned exceedingly, in that I have done this thing; and now, cause to pass away, I pray Thee, the iniquity of Thy servant, for I have acted very foolishly.'
texts.1ch.21.9: And Jehovah speaketh unto Gad, seer of David, saying:
texts.1ch.21.10: `Go, and thou hast spoken unto David, saying, Thus said Jehovah, Three -- I am stretching out unto thee; choose for thee one of these, and I do [it] to thee.'
texts.1ch.21.11: And Gad cometh in unto David, and saith to him, `Thus said Jehovah, Take for thee --
texts.1ch.21.12: either for three years -- famine, or three months to be consumed from the face of thine adversaries, even the sword of thine enemies to overtake, or three days the sword of Jehovah, even pestilence in the land, and a messenger of Jehovah destroying in all the border of Israel; and now, see; what word do I return to Him who is sending me?'
texts.1ch.21.13: And David saith unto Gad, `I am greatly distressed, let me fall, I pray thee, into the hand of Jehovah, for very many [are] His mercies, and into the hand of man let me not fall.'
texts.1ch.21.14: And Jehovah giveth a pestilence in Israel, and there fall of Israel seventy thousand men,
texts.1ch.21.15: and God sendeth a messenger to Jerusalem to destroy it, and as he is destroying Jehovah hath seen, and is comforted concerning the evil, and saith to the messenger who [is] destroying, `Enough, now, cease thy hand.' And the messenger of Jehovah is standing by the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite,
texts.1ch.21.16: and David lifteth up his eyes, and seeth the messenger of Jehovah standing between the earth and the heavens, and his sword drawn in his hand, stretched out over Jerusalem, and David falleth, and the elders, covered with sackcloth, on their faces.
texts.1ch.21.17: And David saith unto God, `Did not I -- I say to number the people? Yea, I it [is] who have sinned, and done great evil: and these, the flock, what did they? O Jehovah, my God, let, I pray Thee, Thy hand be on me, and on the house of my father, and not on Thy people -- to be plagued.'
texts.1ch.21.18: And the messenger of Jehovah spake unto Gad, saying for David, `Surely David doth go up to raise an altar to Jehovah in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.'
texts.1ch.21.19: And David goeth up by the word of Gad, that he spake in the name of Jehovah.
texts.1ch.21.20: And Ornan turneth back, and seeth the messenger, and his four sons [are] with him, hiding themselves, and Ornan is threshing wheat.
texts.1ch.21.21: And David cometh in unto Ornan, and Ornan looketh attentively, and seeth David, and goeth out from the threshing-floor, and boweth himself to David -- face to the earth.
texts.1ch.21.22: And David saith unto Ornan, `Give to me the place of the threshing-floor, and I build in it an altar to Jehovah; for full silver give it to me, and the plague is restrained from the people.'
texts.1ch.21.23: And Ornan saith unto David, `Take to thee -- and my lord the king doth that which is good in his eyes: see, I have given the oxen for burnt-offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for a present; the whole I have given.'
texts.1ch.21.24: And king David saith to Ornan, `Nay, for I surely buy for full silver; for I do not lift up that which is thine to Jehovah, so as to offer a burnt-offering without cost.'
texts.1ch.21.25: And David giveth to Ornan for the place shekels of gold [in] weight six hundred;
texts.1ch.21.26: and David buildeth there an altar to Jehovah, and offereth burnt-offerings and peace-offerings, and calleth unto Jehovah, and He answereth him with fire from the heavens on the altar of the burnt-offering.
texts.1ch.21.27: And Jehovah saith to the messenger, and he turneth back his sword unto its sheath.
texts.1ch.21.28: At that time when David seeth that Jehovah hath answered him in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificeth there;
texts.1ch.21.29: and the tabernacle of Jehovah that Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt-offering, [are] at that time in a high place, in Gibeon;
texts.1ch.21.30: and David is not able to go before it to seek God, for he hath been afraid because of the sword of the messenger of Jehovah.
texts.1ch.22.1: And David saith, `This is the house of Jehovah God, and this the altar for burnt-offering for Israel.'
texts.1ch.22.2: And David saith to gather the sojourners who [are] in the land of Israel, and appointeth hewers to hew hewn-stones to build a house of God.
texts.1ch.22.3: And iron in abundance for nails for leaves of the gates, and for couplings, hath David prepared, and brass in abundance -- there is no weighing.
texts.1ch.22.4: And cedar-trees even without number, for the Zidonians and the Tyrians brought in cedar-trees in abundance to David.
texts.1ch.22.5: And David saith, `Solomon my son [is] a youth and tender, and the house to be built to Jehovah [is] to be made exceedingly great, for name and for beauty to all the lands; let me prepare, I pray Thee, for it;' and David prepareth in abundance before his death.
texts.1ch.22.6: And he calleth for Solomon his son, and chargeth him to build a house to Jehovah, God of Israel,
texts.1ch.22.7: and David saith to Solomon his son, `As for me, it hath been with my heart to build a house to the name of Jehovah my God,
texts.1ch.22.8: and the word of Jehovah [is] against me, saying, Blood in abundance thou hast shed, and great wars thou hast made: thou dost not build a house to My name, for much blood thou hast shed to the earth before Me.
